		private UltraCalculatorDropDown UltraCalculatorDropDown
		{
			get
			{
				if (ultraCalculatorDropDown == null)
				{
					ultraCalculatorDropDown = new UltraCalculatorDropDown();
					ultraCalculatorDropDown.AfterActionButtonPressed += ultraCalculatorDropDown_AfterActionButtonPressed;
					ultraCalculatorDropDown.AfterButtonClicked += ultraCalculatorDropDown_AfterButtonClicked;
					ultraCalculatorDropDown.AfterCalculateImmediate += ultraCalculatorDropDown_AfterCalculateImmediate;
					ultraCalculatorDropDown.AfterCalculatePending += ultraCalculatorDropDown_AfterCalculatePending;
					ultraCalculatorDropDown.AfterCalculationComplete += ultraCalculatorDropDown_AfterCalculationComplete;
					ultraCalculatorDropDown.BeforeActionButtonPressed += ultraCalculatorDropDown_BeforeActionButtonPressed;
					ultraCalculatorDropDown.BeforeButtonClicked += ultraCalculatorDropDown_BeforeButtonClicked;
					ultraCalculatorDropDown.BeforeCalculateImmediate += ultraCalculatorDropDown_BeforeCalculateImmediate;
					ultraCalculatorDropDown.BeforeCalculatePending += ultraCalculatorDropDown_BeforeCalculatePending;
					ultraCalculatorDropDown.DefaultCalculationFail += ultraCalculatorDropDown_DefaultCalculationFail;
				}
				return ultraCalculatorDropDown;
			}
		}

		{
			add
			{
				((UltraColumnBase)this).Events.AddHandler(EVENT_DEFAULTCALCULATIONFAIL, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				((UltraColumnBase)this).Events.RemoveHandler(EVENT_DEFAULTCALCULATIONFAIL, value);
			}
		}

		public UltraCalculatorEditorColumn()
		{
		}

		public UltraCalculatorEditorColumn(IContainer container)
			: this()
		{
		}

		protected override EmbeddableEditorBase CreateEditor()
		{
			return (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)(UltraCalculatorDropDown.Editor as CalcDropDownEditor);
		}

		protected override ColumnOwner CreateOwner()
		{
			return (ColumnOwner)(object)new ColumnOwner(this);
		}

		protected override void InitializeFrom(UltraColumnBase source)
		{
			((UltraTextDropDownEditorColumnBase)this).InitializeFrom(source);
			if (source is UltraCalculatorEditorColumn ultraCalculatorEditorColumn)
			{
				AutoCloseUpOnEquals = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.AutoCloseUpOnEquals;
				AutoDetectDecimalSymbol = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.AutoDetectDecimalSymbol;
				AutoDetectGroupSymbol = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.AutoDetectGroupSymbol;
				CalculatorDropDownStyle = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.CalculatorDropDownStyle;
				if (ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.UltraCalculatorDropDown.HasCalculatorAppearance)
				{
					object obj = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.CalculatorAppearance.Clone();
					CalculatorAppearance = (AppearanceBase)((obj is Appearance) ? obj : null);
				}
				else if (UltraCalculatorDropDown.HasCalculatorAppearance)
				{
					ResetCalculatorAppearance();
				}
				if (ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.UltraCalculatorDropDown.HasCalculatorButtonAppearance)
				{
					object obj2 = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.CalculatorButtonAppearance.Clone();
					CalculatorButtonAppearance = (AppearanceBase)((obj2 is Appearance) ? obj2 : null);
				}
				else if (UltraCalculatorDropDown.HasCalculatorButtonAppearance)
				{
					ResetCalculatorButtonAppearance();
				}
				if (ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.UltraCalculatorDropDown.HasCalculatorButtonHotTrackingAppearance)
				{
					object obj3 = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.CalculatorButtonHotTrackingAppearance.Clone();
					CalculatorButtonHotTrackingAppearance = (AppearanceBase)((obj3 is Appearance) ? obj3 : null);
				}
				else if (UltraCalculatorDropDown.HasCalculatorButtonHotTrackingAppearance)
				{
					ResetCalculatorButtonHotTrackingAppearance();
				}
				if (ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.UltraCalculatorDropDown.HasCalculatorEditAppearance)
				{
					object obj4 = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.CalculatorEditAppearance.Clone();
					CalculatorEditAppearance = (AppearanceBase)((obj4 is Appearance) ? obj4 : null);
				}
				else if (UltraCalculatorDropDown.HasCalculatorEditAppearance)
				{
					ResetCalculatorEditAppearance();
				}
				CalculatorMemoryDisplayText = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.CalculatorMemoryDisplayText;
				CalculatorShowCustomButtons = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.CalculatorShowCustomButtons;
				CalculatorShowMemoryButtons = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.CalculatorShowMemoryButtons;
				DecimalSymbol = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.DecimalSymbol;
				DigitGrouping = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.DigitGrouping;
				DropDownSize = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.DropDownSize;
				GroupSize = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.GroupSize;
				GroupSymbol = ultraCalculatorEditorColumn.GroupSymbol;
			}
		}

namespace Infragistics.Win.UltraWinEditors

	public class WinEditorsControlRole : UltraControlRole
	{
		private StyleUtils.ComponentType componentType;

		private string[] cachedRoleNames;

		internal StyleUtils.ComponentType ComponentType => componentType;

		internal WinEditorsControlRole(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl, StyleUtils.ComponentType componentType)
			: base(ultraCtrl, StyleUtils.GetComponentName(componentType))
		{
			this.componentType = componentType;
			((ComponentRole)this).PropertiesCacheCount = 7;
		}

		protected override string[] GetRoleNames()
		{
			if (cachedRoleNames == null)
			{
				cachedRoleNames = StyleUtils.GetSortedRoleNamesForCaching();
			}
			return cachedRoleNames;
		}

		protected override void OnStyleChanged()
		{
			((UltraControlRole)this).OnStyleChanged();
			if (((ComponentRole)this).Component is UltraToggleEditorBase ultraToggleEditorBase)
			{
				ultraToggleEditorBase.OnAppStyleChanged();
			}
			if (((ComponentRole)this).Component is TextEditorControlBase textEditorControlBase)
			{
				textEditorControlBase.OnAppStyleChanged();
			}
			if (((ComponentRole)this).Component is UltraDateTimeEditor ultraDateTimeEditor)
			{
				ultraDateTimeEditor.OnAppStyleChanged();
			}
			if (((ComponentRole)this).Component is UltraNumericEditorBase ultraNumericEditorBase)
			{
				ultraNumericEditorBase.OnAppStyleChanged();
			}
			if (((ComponentRole)this).Component is UltraOptionSet ultraOptionSet)
			{
				ultraOptionSet.OnAppStyleChanged();
			}
			if (((ComponentRole)this).Component is UltraCalculator ultraCalculator)
			{
				ultraCalculator.OnAppStyleChanged();
			}
			if (((ComponentRole)this).Component is UltraTrackBar ultraTrackBar)
			{
				ultraTrackBar.OnAppStyleChanged();
			}
			if (((ComponentRole)this).Component is UltraPictureBox ultraPictureBox)
			{
				ultraPictureBox.OnAppStyleChanged();
			}
		}
	}
	public class UltraWinEditorsAssemblyStyleInfo : AssemblyStyleInfo
	{
		public override UIRoleDefinition[] GetRoles()
		{
			return StyleUtils.GetRoleDefinitions(StyleUtils.ComponentType.All);
		}

		private ComponentRoleDefinition CreateComponentRoleDef(StyleUtils.ComponentType componentType)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ComponentRoleDefinition val = new ComponentRoleDefinition(StyleUtils.GetComponentName(componentType), StyleUtils.GetComponentType(componentType));
			Type componentEditorType = StyleUtils.GetComponentEditorType(componentType);
			if (null != componentEditorType)
			{
				val.EditorType = componentEditorType;
			}
			val.RelatedRoles = StyleUtils.GetRoleNames(componentType);
			val.CustomProperties = StyleUtils.GetCustomProperties(componentType);
			val.UsesScrollbars = StyleUtils.UseScrollbars(componentType);
			val.UsesToolTips = StyleUtils.UseToolTips(componentType);
			val.SupportedProperties = StyleUtils.GetSupportedProperties(componentType);
			return val;
		}

		public override ComponentRoleDefinition[] GetComponents()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int num = 1; num <= 65536; num <<= 1)
			{
				arrayList.Add(CreateComponentRoleDef((StyleUtils.ComponentType)num));
			}
			return (ComponentRoleDefinition[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(ComponentRoleDefinition));
		}

		public override SharedObjectDefinition[] GetSharedObjects()
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			SharedObjectDefinition val = new SharedObjectDefinition("CalcDropDownEditor", typeof(CalcDropDownEditor));
			val.RelatedComponentRoles = new string[1] { StyleUtils.GetComponentName(StyleUtils.ComponentType.UltraCalculator) };
			arrayList.Add(val);
			return (SharedObjectDefinition[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(SharedObjectDefinition));
		}
	}

		internal static object CachePropertyValue(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl, CachedProperty prop, object controlVal, object defVal, object resolveVal)
		{
			ComponentRole componentRole = GetComponentRole(ultraCtrl);
			if (componentRole != null)
			{
				object obj = null;
				switch (prop)
				{
				case CachedProperty.CheckBoxGlyphInfo:
					obj = componentRole.CheckBoxGlyphInfo;
					break;
				case CachedProperty.RadioButtonGlyphInfo:
					obj = componentRole.RadioButtonGlyphInfo;
					break;
				default:
				{
					string customPropertyName = GetCustomPropertyName(prop);
					if (componentRole.HasProperty(customPropertyName))
					{
						obj = componentRole.GetProperty(customPropertyName);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				return componentRole.CachePropertyValue(obj, controlVal, defVal, resolveVal, (int)prop);
			}
			return ResolveValueHelper(controlVal, defVal, resolveVal);
		}

		internal static string[] Combine(string[] arr1, string[] arr2)
		{
			if (arr1 == null || arr1.Length == 0)
			{
				return arr2;
			}
			if (arr2 == null || arr2.Length == 0)
			{
				return arr1;
			}
			string[] array = new string[arr1.Length + arr2.Length];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < arr1.Length; i++)
			{
				array[num++] = arr1[i];
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < arr2.Length; j++)
			{
				array[num++] = arr2[j];
			}
			return array;
		}

			}

		}

		{

			{

				string text = (string)ROLES[i + 1];
				int num = (int)role;
				if (num >= 0 && num < array.Length && array[num] == null)
				{
					array[num] = text;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal static UIElementButtonStyle ViewStyleToButtonStyle(ViewStyle viewStyle)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UIElementButtonStyle result = (UIElementButtonStyle)0;
			switch (viewStyle - 1)
			{
			case 3:
				result = (UIElementButtonStyle)15;
				break;
			case 2:
				result = (UIElementButtonStyle)12;
				break;
			case 0:
				result = (UIElementButtonStyle)0;
				break;
			case 4:
				result = (UIElementButtonStyle)16;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static bool IsHottracking(Control ctrl)
		{
			if (ctrl == null || !ctrl.Enabled || !ctrl.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Point pt = ctrl.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
			return ctrl.ClientRectangle.Contains(pt);
		}

		protected override void OnEditorKeyDown(KeyEventArgs args)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).OnKeyDown(args);
			if (args.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (args.KeyData == Keys.F4)
			{
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).IsDroppedDown)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).CloseUp();
				}
				else
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).DropDown();
				}
				args.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			if (args.KeyData == Keys.Escape && ((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).IsDroppedDown)
			{
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).CloseUp();
				args.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (args.KeyData == Keys.Tab || args.KeyData == (Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift))
			{
				flag = true;
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).IsInEditMode && !base.AlwaysInEditMode)
				{
					EditorWithText obj = base.ControlEditor;
					ColorPickerEditor val = (ColorPickerEditor)(object)((obj is ColorPickerEditor) ? obj : null);
					if (val != null && ((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).IsDroppedDown)
					{
						return;
					}
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).ExitEditMode(false, true);
				}
				bool focusToNextControl = true;
				if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) == Keys.Shift)
				{
					focusToNextControl = false;
				}
				try
				{
					if (TextEditorControlBase.IsOnUserControl((Control)(object)this))
					{
						dontEnterEditModeOnFocus = true;
						if (Focus())
						{
							args.Handled = ((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(args.KeyData);
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					dontEnterEditModeOnFocus = false;
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).SetFocusToNextControl(focusToNextControl);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				IEmbeddableTextBoxListener val2 = (IEmbeddableTextBoxListener)(object)base.ControlEditor;
				val2.OnKeyDown(args);
			}
		}

			private int GetFirstLastLineCaretPosition(TextUIElement textUIElement, int caretPosition, bool first)
			{
				int lineNumber = ((TextUIElementBase)textUIElement).GetLineNumber(caretPosition);
				return GetFirstLastLineCaretPosition(textUIElement, caretPosition, lineNumber, first);
			}

			private int GetFirstLastLineCaretPosition(TextUIElement textUIElement, int caretPosition, int targetLineNumber, bool first)
			{
				int val = caretPosition;
				int num = targetLineNumber;
				while (num == targetLineNumber && caretPosition >= 0)
				{
					if (first)
					{
						val = caretPosition;
						caretPosition--;
					}
					else
					{
						caretPosition++;
						val = caretPosition;
					}
					if (caretPosition < 0 || caretPosition >= ((TextUIElementBase)textUIElement).Text.Length)
					{
						break;
					}
					num = ((TextUIElementBase)textUIElement).GetLineNumber(caretPosition);
				}
				if (first)
				{
					return Math.Max(val, 0);
				}
				return Math.Min(val, ((TextUIElementBase)textUIElement).Text.Length);
			}

			private int GetLineLength(TextUIElement textUIElement, int caretPosition, int lineNumber)
			{
				int startOfLine;
				int endOfLine;
				return GetLineLength(textUIElement, caretPosition, lineNumber, out startOfLine, out endOfLine);
			}

			private int GetLineLength(TextUIElement textUIElement, int caretPosition, int lineNumber, out int startOfLine, out int endOfLine)
			{
				startOfLine = GetFirstLastLineCaretPosition(textUIElement, caretPosition, lineNumber, first: true);
				endOfLine = GetFirstLastLineCaretPosition(textUIElement, caretPosition, lineNumber, first: false);
				return endOfLine - startOfLine;
			}

			protected override void WndProc(ref Message msg)
			{
				if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages), msg.Msg))
				{
					if (control.IsInEditMode)

						msg = ForwardMessageToTextBox(msg);
						return;
					}
					switch ((NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages)msg.Msg)
					{
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.WM_CLEAR:

							control.SelectedText = null;
						}
						return;
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_GETSEL:

							num10 = num9 + control.SelectionLength;

							num9 = 0;
							num10 = 0;

						}
						if (msg.LParam != IntPtr.Zero)

						{

							return;
						}
						if (num12 > num13)
						{

							num12 = num13;
							num13 = num14;
						}
						control.SelectionStart = num12;
						control.SelectionLength = num13 - num12;
						return;
					}
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_REPLACESEL:

						}
						break;
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_GETLINECOUNT:
					{

					}

						if (textUIElement4 != null)

					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_LINEINDEX:
					{

						{

						}

						if (textUIElement2 == null)
						{

						}

						if (num != -1)

							num2 = GetLineLength(textUIElement, num, lineNumber, out startOfLine, out endOfLine);

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public string SelectedText
		{
			get
			{
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					return ((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).SelectedText;
				}
				string text = ((Control)(object)this).Text;
				int selectionStart = SelectionStart;
				int selectionLength = SelectionLength;
				Utilities.VerifySelStartAndSelLength(text, ref selectionStart, ref selectionLength);
				return text.Substring(selectionStart, selectionLength);
			}
			set
			{
				bool isInEditMode = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).IsInEditMode;
				string selectedText = SelectedText;
				if (value != selectedText)
				{
					if (isInEditMode)
					{
						((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).SelectedText = value;
					}
					else
					{
						((Control)(object)this).Text = Utilities.ReplaceSubString(((Control)(object)this).Text, SelectionStart, SelectionLength, value);
						cachedSelStart += value?.Length ?? 0;
						cachedSelLength = 0;
					}
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)17);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraTextEditor_P_Text")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		[Bindable(BindableSupport.Yes)]
		public override string Text
		{
			get
			{
				EditorWithText val = ControlEditor;
				if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).IsInEditMode || ((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).IsEnteringEditMode)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(textValue))
					{
						switch (CharacterCasing)
						{
						case CharacterCasing.Lower:
							textValue = textValue.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
							break;
						case CharacterCasing.Upper:
							textValue = textValue.ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
							break;
						}
					}
					if (textValue != null)
					{
						return textValue;
					}
					return string.Empty;
				}
				object value = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).Value;
				if (value != null)
				{
					textValue = value.ToString();
					return textValue;
				}
				if (textValue == null)
				{
					textValue = NullText;
				}
				return textValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == textValue)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					methodInProgressFlags.inTextPropertySet = true;
					Modified = false;
					if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).IsInEditMode)
					{
						textValue = value;
						((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
						((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)19);
						FireValueChanged(new EventArgs());
						((Control)(object)this).OnTextChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
						return;
					}
					didTextChangedEventFireWhenSettingTheEditorValue = false;
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).Value = value;
					((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)19);
					if (!didTextChangedEventFireWhenSettingTheEditorValue)
					{
						((Control)(object)this).OnTextChanged(new EventArgs());
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					methodInProgressFlags.inTextPropertySet = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void SetText(string text)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
			CharacterCasing characterCasing = CharacterCasing;
			if (characterCasing != CharacterCasing.Normal)
			{
				text = ((characterCasing == CharacterCasing.Upper) ? text.ToUpper() : text.ToLower());
			}
			textValue = text;
			if (isInitializing && CanSetText)
			{
				initialTextSet = true;
				initialText = textValue;
			}
		}

		protected virtual string GetText()
		{
			return textValue;
		}

				form.Deactivate += OnFormDeactivate;

		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				Form form = ParentForm;
				if (form != null && !form.IsDisposed)
				{
					form.Activated -= OnFormActivate;
					form.Deactivate -= OnFormDeactivate;
				}
				if (controlEditor != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)controlEditor).Disposed)
				{
					((Control)(object)controlEditor.TextBox).GotFocus -= OnEditorTextBoxGotFocus;
					((DisposableObject)(object)controlEditor).Dispose();
				}
				if (providedEditor != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)providedEditor).Disposed)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)providedEditor).Dispose();
				}
				if (!((DisposableObject)(object)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).Disposed)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).Dispose();
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).PropertyChanged -= PropertyChangedHandler;
				((UltraControlBase)this).Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			((EditorButtonControlBase)this).OnGotFocus(e);
			if (!dontEnterEditModeOnFocus && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).IsEnteringEditMode && !methodInProgressFlags.inOnLeave)
			{
				OnGotFocusHelper();
			}
		}

		private void OnGotFocusHelper()
		{
			if (((Control)this).CanFocus)
			{
				if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
					EmbeddableUIElementBase val = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant : null);
					if (val != null)
					{
						((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).EnterEditMode(val);
					}
					if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).CanFocus && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).Focused)
					{
						((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).ExitEditMode(false, true);
					}
				}
				else if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).CanFocus && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).Focused)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).Focus();
				}
			}
			if (IsFocused && (!useBaseFocused || !hasCancelledEnterEditMode))
			{
				((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)new MethodInvoker(DelayedInvokeEditorFocus));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEnter(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (methodInProgressFlags.inOnEnter)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				bool focused = ((Control)(object)this).Focused;
				methodInProgressFlags.inOnEnter = true;
				((Control)this).OnEnter(e);
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
				if (((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).ChildElements).Count == 0)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
				}
				UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
				EmbeddableUIElementBase val = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant : null);
				if (val != null && ((Control)this).CanFocus && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).EnterEditMode(val);
					if (wasLastValidationCancelled || (hasProcessedEnter && !focused))
					{
						RestorePreviousSelection();
					}
				}
				else if ((wasLastValidationCancelled || alwaysInEditMode) && ((Control)this).IsHandleCreated && ((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).CanFocus && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).Focused)
				{
					((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)new MethodInvoker(DelayedInvokeEditorFocus));
				}
				wasLastValidationCancelled = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				methodInProgressFlags.inOnEnter = false;
				if ((object)EmbeddableEditorBase.pendingCanceledEditModeControl == this)
				{
					EmbeddableEditorBase.pendingCanceledEditModeControl = null;
				}
				hasProcessedEnter = true;
			}
		}

		private void DelayedInvokeEditorFocus()
		{
			if (((Control)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)this).Disposing || !((Control)this).ContainsFocus)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).IsInEditMode)
			{
				UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
				EmbeddableUIElementBase val = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).EnterEditMode(val);
				}
				RestorePreviousSelection();
			}
			else if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).CanFocus && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).Focused)
			{
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).Focus();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (methodInProgressFlags.inOnLeave)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				methodInProgressFlags.inOnLeave = true;
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).IsInEditMode && !alwaysInEditMode)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).ExitEditMode(false, true);
				}
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((Control)this).OnLeave(e);
			}
			finally
			{
				methodInProgressFlags.inOnLeave = false;
			}
		}

		internal void OnValidatingHelper(CancelEventArgs e, bool callBase)
		{
			if (callBase)
			{
				((Control)this).OnValidating(e);
			}
			wasLastValidationCancelled = e.Cancel;
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				dontEnterEditModeOnFocus = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEnabledChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			SyncBackColor();
			((Control)this).OnEnabledChanged(e);
			if (!((Control)this).Enabled && IsInEditMode)
			{
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).ExitEditMode(false, true);
			}
			else if (((Control)this).Enabled && AlwaysInEditMode && !IsInEditMode)
			{
				EnterEditMode(takeFocus: false);
			}
			else if (((Control)this).Enabled && !IsInEditMode && controlEditor.TextBox != null && !((Control)(object)controlEditor.TextBox).Visible && Utilities.IsActiveControl((Control)(object)controlEditor.TextBox))
			{
				EnterEditMode(takeFocus: false);
			}
		}

		public void AppendText(string text)
		{
			if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text2 = ((((Control)(object)this).Text == null) ? text : (((Control)(object)this).Text += text));
			if (text2.Length > MaxLength)
			{
				text2 = text2.Substring(0, MaxLength);
			}
			((Control)(object)this).Text = text2;
			if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).SupportsSelectableText)
			{
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)ControlEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					SelectionStart = ((Control)(object)this).Text.Length;
					SelectionLength = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					cachedSelStart = ((Control)(object)this).Text.Length;
					cachedSelLength = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Clear()

		internal bool EnterEditMode(bool takeFocus)
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (mainElement == null || ControlEditor == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			mainElement.VerifyChildElements();
			UIElement descendant = mainElement.GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
			EmbeddableUIElementBase val = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ControlEditor.EnterEditMode(val, takeFocus);
		}

		internal static HorizontalAlignment GetHorizontalAlignmentFromHAlign(HAlign alignment)
		{

			//IL_0011: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)alignment == 0 || (int)alignment == 1)
			{
				return HorizontalAlignment.Left;
			}

		private void ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref Size proposedSize)
		{
			Size minimumSize = ((Control)(object)this).MinimumSize;
			Size maximumSize = ((Control)(object)this).MaximumSize;
			if (maximumSize.Width == 0)
			{
				maximumSize.Width = int.MaxValue;
			}
			if (maximumSize.Height == 0)
			{
				maximumSize.Height = int.MaxValue;
			}
			proposedSize.Width = Math.Max(minimumSize.Width, Math.Min(proposedSize.Width, maximumSize.Width));
			proposedSize.Height = Math.Max(minimumSize.Height, Math.Min(proposedSize.Height, maximumSize.Height));
		}

			{
				((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
		}

		{
		}
	}

		private void PopulateList()
		{
			listBox.Items.Clear();
			Array values = Enum.GetValues(typeof(Keys));
			string[] names = Enum.GetNames(typeof(Keys));
			for (int i = 0; i < values.GetLength(0); i++)
			{
				KeyCodeObject item = new KeyCodeObject((Keys)values.GetValue(i), names[i]);
				listBox.Items.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public Keys GetValue()
		{
			if (commitValue)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			return originalValue;
		}

			{
				newValue = keyCodeObject.KeyValue;
				ok.Enabled = true;
			}
		}

		private void txtAssignKey_KeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			ok.Enabled = false;
			commitValue = false;
			newValue = originalValue;
			if (e.KeyData == Keys.Back)
			{
				txtAssignKey.Text = string.Empty;
				return;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			Keys keys = e.KeyData & ~e.Modifiers;
			if (keys == Keys.None || keys == Keys.ControlKey || keys == Keys.ShiftKey)
			{
				empty = string.Empty;
			}
			else
			{
				empty = string.Empty;
				if ((e.KeyData & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control)
				{
					empty += "Ctrl+";
				}
				if ((e.KeyData & Keys.Shift) == Keys.Shift)
				{
					empty += "Shift+";
				}
				if ((e.KeyData & Keys.Alt) == Keys.Alt)
				{
					empty += "Alt+";
				}
				empty += keys;
			}
			if (empty.Length > 0)
			{
				txtAssignKey.Text = empty;
				txtAssignKey.SelectionLength = 0;
				txtAssignKey.SelectionStart = txtAssignKey.Text.Length;
				ok.Enabled = true;
				newValue = e.KeyData;
			}
		}

		private void txtAssignKey_KeyPress(object sender, KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void frmKeyCodeUIEditor_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void tabControl1_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (tabControl1.SelectedIndex == 0)
			{
				base.AcceptButton = null;
				base.CancelButton = null;
				txtAssignKey.Focus();
			}
			else
			{
				base.AcceptButton = ok;
				base.CancelButton = cancel;
				listBox.Focus();
			}
		}

		private void frmKeyCodeUIEditor_Activated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.AcceptButton = null;
			base.CancelButton = null;
			txtAssignKey.Focus();
		}
	}
	public sealed class KeyCodeTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_0"));
			}
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(InstanceDescriptor);
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is Keys)
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(object[]).GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
				if (constructor != null)
				{
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
				}
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return value.ToString();
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

		private void frmMRUItemsUIEditor_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		public frmMRUItemsUIEditor(ValueList valueList, object[] mruList, int maxMRUItems)
		{
			if (valueList != null && ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)valueList.ValueListItems).Count != 0)
			{
				InitializeComponent();
				this.valueList = valueList;
				this.mruList = mruList;
				this.maxMRUItems = maxMRUItems;
				ok.Enabled = false;
				base.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterScreen;
				PopulateList();
			}
		}

		private void PopulateList()
		{
			listBox.Items.Clear();
			string empty = string.Empty;
			ValueListItemEnumerator enumerator = valueList.ValueListItems.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (((DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase)(object)enumerator).MoveNext())
				{
					ValueListItem current = enumerator.Current;
					bool isChecked = IsItemInMRUList(current);
					listBox.Items.Add(current, isChecked);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsItemInMRUList(ValueListItem item)
		{
			if (mruList == null || mruList.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object[] array = mruList;
			foreach (object obj in array)
			{
				IComparable comparable = obj as IComparable;
				IComparable obj2 = item.DataValue as IComparable;
				if (comparable.Equals(obj2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object[] GetMRUList()
		{
			if (!commitList)
			{
				return mruList;
			}
			object[] array = new object[listBox.CheckedItems.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < listBox.CheckedItems.Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = listBox.CheckedItems[i];
				ValueListItem val = (ValueListItem)((obj is ValueListItem) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					array[i] = val.DataValue;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void ok_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			commitList = true;
			Close();
		}

		private void cancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			commitList = false;
			Close();
		}

		private void listBox_ItemCheck(object sender, ItemCheckEventArgs e)
		{
			ok.Enabled = true;
			if (listBox.CheckedItems.Count == maxMRUItems && e.CurrentValue != CheckState.Checked)
			{
				string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MRUListItemEditor_TooManyItems_MessageBoxText");
				string text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MRUListItemEditor_TooManyItems_MessageBoxCaption");
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(text, text2, MessageBoxButtons.OK);
				e.NewValue = CheckState.Unchecked;
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class MRUListTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_0"));
			}
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(InstanceDescriptor);
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is object[])
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(object[]).GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
				if (constructor != null)
				{
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
				}
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				if (value is object[] array && array.Length != 0)
				{
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_MRUItemsUIEditor_CountEquals", array.Length);
				}
				return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_MRUItemsUIEditor_NoItems");
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, Name = "FullTrust")]
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "FullTrust")]
	public class MRUListUIEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
			object[] array = value as object[];
			if (!(context.Instance is UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)ultraComboEditor.Items).Count == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_16"));
			}
			if (ultraComboEditor.ShouldSerializeDataSource())
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_MRUListUIEditor_NotWhenBound"));
			}
			frmMRUItemsUIEditor frmMRUItemsUIEditor2 = new frmMRUItemsUIEditor(ultraComboEditor.ValueList, ultraComboEditor.MRUList, ultraComboEditor.MaxMRUItems);
			edSvc.ShowDialog(frmMRUItemsUIEditor2);
			value = frmMRUItemsUIEditor2.GetMRUList();
			return value;
		}
	}

		private void OnSubObjectPropChange(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			bool uiElements = false;
			bool invalidate = false;
			bool cachedStyleProperties = false;
			bool autoSize = false;
			UltraRadioButtonGroupManager ultraRadioButtonGroupManager = GroupManager;
			if (GroupManager != null && propChangeInfo.Source == groupManager)
			{
				Enum propId = propChangeInfo.Trigger.PropId;
				if (propId is RadioButtonGroupManagerPropertyIds)
				{
					switch ((RadioButtonGroupManagerPropertyIds)(object)propId)
					{
					case RadioButtonGroupManagerPropertyIds.Appearance:
					case RadioButtonGroupManagerPropertyIds.HotTrackingAppearance:
					case RadioButtonGroupManagerPropertyIds.CheckedAppearance:
						autoSize = true;
						uiElements = true;
						cachedStyleProperties = true;
						invalidate = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Dirty(uiElements, invalidate, cachedStyleProperties, autoSize);
			((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange(propChangeInfo.PropId, propChangeInfo);
		}

		internal override void SynchronizeRadioButtons(bool tabbedInto)
		{
			if (firstFocus)
			{
				WipeTabStops(tabbedInto);
			}
			((Control)(object)this).TabStop = base.Checked;
			if (!base.Checked)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<UltraRadioButton> allRadioButtonsInGroup = GetAllRadioButtonsInGroup(excludeThisItem: true);
			if (allRadioButtonsInGroup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraRadioButton item in allRadioButtonsInGroup)
			{
				if (item.Checked)
				{
					item.Checked = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private void WipeTabStops(bool tabbedInto)
		{
			Control parent = ((Control)(object)this).Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control.ControlCollection controls = parent.Controls;
			for (int i = 0; i < controls.Count; i++)
			{
				if (controls[i] is UltraRadioButton ultraRadioButton)
				{
					if (!tabbedInto)
					{
						ultraRadioButton.firstFocus = false;
					}
					((Control)(object)ultraRadioButton).TabStop = false;
				}
			}
		}

		}

		internal IEnumerable<UltraRadioButton> GetAllRadioButtonsInGroup(bool excludeThisItem)
		{
			IEnumerable<UltraRadioButton> result = null;
			if (GroupManager != null)
			{
				UltraRadioButton excludedUltraRadioButton = (excludeThisItem ? this : null);
				result = GroupManager.GetAllRadioButtonsInGroup(excludedUltraRadioButton);
			}
			else
			{
				Control parent = ((Control)(object)this).Parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					HashSet<UltraRadioButton> hashSet = new HashSet<UltraRadioButton>();
					Control.ControlCollection controls = parent.Controls;
					for (int i = 0; i < controls.Count; i++)
					{
						if (controls[i] is UltraRadioButton ultraRadioButton && (!excludeThisItem || this != ultraRadioButton) && ultraRadioButton.GroupManager == null)
						{
							hashSet.Add(ultraRadioButton);
						}
					}
					result = hashSet;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public UltraRadioButton GetSelectedUltraRadioButton()
		{
			IEnumerable<UltraRadioButton> allRadioButtonsInGroup = GetAllRadioButtonsInGroup();
			if (allRadioButtonsInGroup != null)
			{
				foreach (UltraRadioButton item in allRadioButtonsInGroup)
				{
					if (item.Checked)
					{
						return item;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, CheckState checkState)
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((long)requestedProps != 0L && checkState == CheckState.Checked && base.ToggleEditor.HasCheckedAppearance)
			{
				base.ToggleEditor.CheckedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			UltraRadioButtonGroupManager ultraRadioButtonGroupManager = GroupManager;
			if (ultraRadioButtonGroupManager != null && (long)requestedProps != 0L && checkState == CheckState.Checked && ultraRadioButtonGroupManager.HasCheckedAppearance)
			{
				ultraRadioButtonGroupManager.CheckedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
			UIRole mainRole = StyleUtils.GetMainRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && mainRole != null)
			{
				mainRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if ((long)requestedProps != 0L && base.HasAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				base.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if ((long)requestedProps != 0L && ultraRadioButtonGroupManager != null && ultraRadioButtonGroupManager.HasAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				ultraRadioButtonGroupManager.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && mainRole != null)
			{
				mainRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)32))

			}
		}

		internal IEnumerable<UltraRadioButton> GetAllRadioButtonsInGroup(UltraRadioButton excludedUltraRadioButton)
		{
			HashSet<UltraRadioButton> hashSet = new HashSet<UltraRadioButton>(radioButtons);
			if (excludedUltraRadioButton != null && hashSet.Contains(excludedUltraRadioButton))
			{
				hashSet.Remove(excludedUltraRadioButton);
			}
			return hashSet;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetAllowAllUp();
			ResetAppearance();
			ResetHotTrackingAppearance();
			ResetCheckedAppearance();
		}

		private void VerifySelectedRadioButton(UltraRadioButton ultraRadioButton)
		{
			if ((selectedRadioButton != ultraRadioButton && ultraRadioButton.Checked) || (AllowAllUp && selectedRadioButton == ultraRadioButton && !ultraRadioButton.Checked))
			{
				UltraRadioButton newSelectedRadioButton = (ultraRadioButton.Checked ? ultraRadioButton : null);
				RadioButtonGroupManagerSelectionChangedEventArgs e = new RadioButtonGroupManagerSelectionChangedEventArgs(selectedRadioButton, newSelectedRadioButton);
				selectedRadioButton = newSelectedRadioButton;
				FireEvent(UltraRadioButtonGroupManagerEventIds.SelectionChanged, e);
			}
		}

		internal void FireEvent(UltraRadioButtonGroupManagerEventIds id, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!EventManager.CanFireEvent(id) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(UltraRadioButtonGroupManagerEventIds), id))
			{
				return;
			}
			EventManager.IncrementInProgress(id);
			try
			{
				if (id == UltraRadioButtonGroupManagerEventIds.SelectionChanged)
				{
					OnSelectionChanged(e as RadioButtonGroupManagerSelectionChangedEventArgs);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(id);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnSelectionChanged(RadioButtonGroupManagerSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			((EventHandler<RadioButtonGroupManagerSelectionChangedEventArgs>)((UltraComponentBase)this).Events[EVENT_SELECTIONCHANGED])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		private void UltraRadioButton_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UltraRadioButton ultraRadioButton = (UltraRadioButton)sender;
			VerifySelectedRadioButton(ultraRadioButton);
		}

		private void UltraRadioButton_Disposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UltraRadioButton ultraRadioButton = (UltraRadioButton)sender;
			Unregister(ultraRadioButton);
		}

			}
			set
			{
				if (Checked != value)
				{
					if (value)
					{
						CheckState = CheckState.Checked;
					}
					else
					{
						CheckState = CheckState.Unchecked;
					}
					((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)93);
				}
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public object CheckedValue
		{
			get
			{
				return ((EmbeddableEditorBase)ToggleEditor).GetDataFilteredDestinationValue(checkedValue, (ConversionDirection)3, OwnerInfo, (object)this);
			}
			set
			{
				value = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)ToggleEditor).GetDataFilteredDestinationValue(value, (ConversionDirection)2, OwnerInfo, (object)this);
				if (value == checkedValue)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!(value is bool) && value != DBNull.Value && value != null && !(value is CheckState))
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_UltraCheckEditor_Invalid_CheckedValue"));
				}
				object obj = ((value == null) ? DBNull.Value : value);
				CheckState checkState;
				if (value is CheckState)
				{
					checkState = (CheckState)value;
				}
				else
				{
					checkState = CheckState.Indeterminate;
					if (obj is bool)
					{
						checkState = (((bool)obj) ? CheckState.Checked : CheckState.Unchecked);
					}
				}
				CheckState = checkState;
				if (CheckState == checkState)
				{
					checkedValue = obj;
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)75);
					if (UIElement != null)
					{
						UIElement.DirtyChildElements();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		{

			{
				if (ultraCheckEditorUIAutomationStub == null)
				{
					ultraCheckEditorUIAutomationStub = new UltraToggleEditorUIAutomationStub(this, (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)toggleEditor, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)ownerInfo);
				}
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)ultraCheckEditorUIAutomationStub).Provider;
			}
			return ((UltraControlBase)this).CreateUIAutomationProvider(context);
		}

		internal virtual CheckState UIAGetPreviousCheckState()
		{
			CheckState result = CheckState.Unchecked;
			switch (CheckState)
			{
			case CheckState.Checked:
				result = CheckState.Unchecked;
				break;
			case CheckState.Unchecked:
				result = CheckState.Checked;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override Size GetPreferredSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d9: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01dc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!((Control)(object)this).AutoSize)
			{
				return ((Control)this).GetPreferredSize(proposedSize);
			}
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011976;
			ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			Font font = ((Control)(object)this).Font;
			Font font2 = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).CreateFont(font);
			if (font2 != null)
			{
				font = font2;
			}
			Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).GetImage((ImageList)null);
			if (image != null)
			{
				num = image.Height + 4;
				num2 += image.Width + 4;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((Control)(object)this).Text))
			{
				Graphics cachedGraphics = OwnerInfo.GetCachedGraphics((object)this);
				try
				{
					Size size = DrawUtility.MeasureString(cachedGraphics, ((Control)(object)this).Text, font, OwnerInfo, (object)this).ToSize();
					num2 += size.Width + 4;
					num = Math.Max(num, size.Height + 4);
				}
				finally
				{
					font2?.Dispose();
					OwnerInfo.ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);
				}
			}
			if ((int)Style == 0)
			{
				Size glyphSize = UIElementDrawParams.GetGlyphSize((GlyphType)0, (UIElement)null);
				ControlUIElementBase controlUIElement = ((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement;
				if (controlUIElement != null)
				{
					glyphSize = UIElementDrawParams.GetGlyphSize((GlyphType)0, OwnerInfo, (object)this, controlUIElement);
				}
				switch (CheckAlign)
				{
				case ContentAlignment.TopLeft:
				case ContentAlignment.TopRight:
				case ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft:
				case ContentAlignment.MiddleRight:
				case ContentAlignment.BottomLeft:
				case ContentAlignment.BottomRight:
					num2 += glyphSize.Width + 2;
					num = Math.Max(num, glyphSize.Height);
					break;
				case ContentAlignment.TopCenter:
				case ContentAlignment.BottomCenter:
					num += glyphSize.Height + 2;
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, glyphSize.Width);
					break;
				case ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter:
					num *= 2;
					num += glyphSize.Height + 2;
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, glyphSize.Width);
					break;

			}

				UIElementBorderWidths val = DrawUtility.CalculateButtonBorderWidths(ButtonStyleResolved, (UIElementButtonState)16);
				num2 += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;

			}
			if (TouchProviderManager.AreTouchMetricsEnabled((Control)(object)this))
			{
				Size touchElementSize = TouchUtilities.GetTouchElementSize((Control)(object)this, (TouchElementSizes)0);
				num = Math.Max(num, touchElementSize.Height);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, touchElementSize.Width);
			}
			Size proposedSize2 = new Size(num2, num);
			ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref proposedSize2);
			return proposedSize2;
		}

		private void ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref Size proposedSize)
		{
			Size minimumSize = ((Control)(object)this).MinimumSize;
			Size maximumSize = ((Control)(object)this).MaximumSize;
			if (maximumSize.Width == 0)
			{
				maximumSize.Width = int.MaxValue;
			}
			if (maximumSize.Height == 0)
			{
				maximumSize.Height = int.MaxValue;
			}
			proposedSize.Width = Math.Max(minimumSize.Width, Math.Min(proposedSize.Width, maximumSize.Width));
			proposedSize.Height = Math.Max(minimumSize.Height, Math.Min(proposedSize.Height, maximumSize.Height));
		}

			}
			set
			{
				if (ThreeState != value)
				{
					CheckEditor.ThreeState = value;
					SynchronizeEditorProperties();
					((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)91);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeThreeState()
		{
			return ThreeState;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetThreeState()
		{
			ThreeState = false;
		}

		internal override void DoCheck()
		{
			if (base.CheckState == CheckState.Unchecked)
			{
				base.CheckState = CheckState.Checked;
			}
			else if (base.CheckState == CheckState.Indeterminate)
			{
				base.CheckState = CheckState.Checked;
			}
			else if (ThreeState)
			{
				base.CheckState = CheckState.Indeterminate;
			}
			else
			{
				base.CheckState = CheckState.Unchecked;
			}
		}

		internal override void SynchronizeEditorProperties()
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase editor = base.Editor;
			CheckEditor val = (CheckEditor)(object)((editor is CheckEditor) ? editor : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.ThreeState = CheckEditor.ThreeState;
				base.SynchronizeEditorProperties();
			}
		}

		internal override CheckState UIAGetPreviousCheckState()
		{
			CheckState result = CheckState.Unchecked;
			if (ThreeState)
			{
				switch (base.CheckState)
				{
				case CheckState.Checked:
					result = CheckState.Indeterminate;
					break;
				case CheckState.Unchecked:
					result = CheckState.Checked;
					break;
				case CheckState.Indeterminate:
					result = CheckState.Unchecked;
					break;
				}
				return result;
			}
			return base.UIAGetPreviousCheckState();
		}
	}

		}

		public override bool ResolveAppearance(object ownerContext, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, EmbeddableEditorArea area, bool hotTracking, string customArea)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (hotTracking && base.ToggleEditorBaseControl.HasHotTrackingAppearance)
			{
				base.ToggleEditorBaseControl.HotTrackingAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if ((int)area == 8)
			{
				CheckState checkState = (CheckState)Enum.Parse(typeof(CheckState), customArea);
				base.ToggleEditorBaseControl.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, checkState);
				return true;
			}
			base.ToggleEditorBaseControl.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			return true;
		}
	}

		[Bindable(true)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraColorPicker_P_Color")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0035: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (colorValue == Color.Empty && !AllowEmpty)
				{
					return DefaultColorResolved;
				}
				if (colorValue.IsSystemColor && (int)StyleResolved == 2)
				{
					return DefaultColorResolved;
				}
				return colorValue;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (value == colorValue)
				{
					return;
				}
				Color color = value;
				if (value == Color.Empty)
				{
					if (!AllowEmpty)
					{
						color = DefaultColorResolved;
					}
				}
				else if (value.IsSystemColor && (int)StyleResolved == 2)
				{
					color = DefaultColorResolved;
				}
				colorValue = color;
				if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)ColorPickerEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					Modified = false;
					OnTextChanged(new EventArgs());
					FireValueChanged(new EventArgs());
					OnAllColorChanged();
				}
				else
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)ColorPickerEditor).Value = color;
				}
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		public override string Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).IsInEditMode && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).IsEnteringEditMode)
				{
					string currentEditText = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).CurrentEditText;
					SetText(currentEditText);
					return currentEditText;
				}
				return GetDisplayStrFromColor(colorValue);
			}
			set
			{
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).IsInEditMode && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).IsEnteringEditMode)
				{
					if (((EditorButtonControlBase)this).DataFilter != null)
					{
						((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).Value = ColorPickerEditor.ColorFromString(value, DefaultColorResolved, AllowEmpty);
					}
					else
					{
						((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).Value = value;
					}
					return;
				}
				Color color = ColorPickerEditor.ColorFromString(value, DefaultColorResolved, AllowEmpty);
				if (colorValue != color)
				{
					colorValue = color;
					Modified = false;
					OnTextChanged(new EventArgs());
					FireValueChanged(new EventArgs());
					OnAllColorChanged();
					if (UIElement != null)
					{
						UIElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(PaletteInfoConverter))]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraColorPicker_P_PaletteInfo")]
		public UltraPaletteInfo PaletteInfo
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (paletteInfo == null)
				{
					paletteInfo = new UltraPaletteInfo();
					paletteInfo.ResetToDefaultPalette();
					ComponentContainer.Add((IComponent)paletteInfo);
					OnPaletteInfoAttach(paletteInfo, null);
				}
				return paletteInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				if (paletteInfo == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				UltraPaletteInfo val = paletteInfo;
				if (val != null && componentContainer != null)
				{
					foreach (IComponent component in componentContainer.Components)
					{
						if (component is UltraPaletteInfo)
						{
							componentContainer.Remove(component);
							component.Dispose();
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				paletteInfo = value;
				OnPaletteInfoAttach(paletteInfo, val);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnValueChanged(EventArgs args)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).IsValid && ((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).Value != null)
			{
				try
				{
					colorValue = (Color)((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).Value;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				SetText(GetDisplayStrFromColor((Color)((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).Value));
			}
			if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).CurrentEditText.Length == 0)
			{
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).Value = (AllowEmpty ? Color.Empty : DefaultColor);
				if (UIElement != null)
				{
					UIElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
				}
			}
			OnTextChanged(new EventArgs());
			Modified = true;
			if (lastValidColor != colorValue)
			{
				FireValueChanged(args);
				OnAllColorChanged();
				lastValidColor = colorValue;
			}
		}

		internal override bool InternalSetValue(object newVal)
		{
			if (!(newVal is Color color))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.IsInEditMode)
			{
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).Value = color;
			}
			else
			{
				colorValue = color;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool InternalGetValue(out object val)
		{
			if (base.IsInEditMode)
			{
				val = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.ControlEditor).Value;
			}
			else
			{
				val = colorValue;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnAfterEnterEditMode(EventArgs args)

				if (value == null)
				{
					if (cachedSelectedIndex == -1)
					{
						return;
					}
					cachedSelectedIndex = -1;
				}
				else
				{
					cachedSelectedIndex = Items.IndexOf(value);
				}
				SynchronizeText();
				if (num != cachedSelectedIndex)
				{
					FireValueChanged(new EventArgs());
					FireSelectionChanged(new EventArgs());
					if (text != GetText())
					{
						OnTextChanged(new EventArgs());
					}
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)23);
				}
				SafeDirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public int SelectedIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).IsInEditMode && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).IsEnteringEditMode && !hasNeverEnteredEditModeBefore)
				{
					return EditorWithCombo.SelectedIndex;
				}
				return cachedSelectedIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).IsInEditMode)
				{
					EditorWithCombo.SelectedIndex = value;
				}
				else
				{
					if (value == cachedSelectedIndex)
					{
						return;
					}
					int num = cachedSelectedIndex;
					string text = GetText();
					int newValue = value;
					VerifySelectedIndex(ref newValue);
					cachedSelectedIndex = newValue;
					SynchronizeText();
					if (num != cachedSelectedIndex)
					{
						FireValueChanged(new EventArgs());
						FireSelectionChanged(new EventArgs());
						if (text != GetText())
						{
							OnTextChanged(new EventArgs());
						}
					}
					SafeDirtyChildElements();
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)24);
				}
			}
		}

		public void DataBind()

			if (!ShouldSerializeDataSource())

				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_UltraComboEditor_M_DataBind_NotBound"));
			}
			BindableValueList.RefreshDataItems();
			if (UIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UIElement)UIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		private void DisposeValueList()
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (valueList != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)ValueList).Disposed)
			{
				ValueList.ListChanged -= new ValueListChangedEventHandler(ValueList_ListChanged);
				((SubObjectBase)(object)ValueList).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				valueList.BeforeDropDownResizeStart -= BeforeDropDownResizeHandler;
				valueList.AfterDropDownResize -= AfterDropDownResizeHandler;
				BindableValueList bindableValueList = BindableValueList;
				if (bindableValueList != null)
				{
					bindableValueList.InitializeDataItem -= new InitializeDataItemHandler(OnBindableValueListInitializeDataItem);
				}
			}
			if (valueList != null && shouldDisposeValueList)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)valueList).Dispose();
				valueList = null;
				shouldDisposeValueList = false;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)DropDownStyle == 0 && (keyData == Keys.Tab || keyData == (Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift)))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotFocus(e);
			if (dontEnterEditModeOnFocus)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).IsInEditMode)
			{
				UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(EditorWithComboUIElement));
				EditorWithComboUIElement val = (EditorWithComboUIElement)(object)((descendant is EditorWithComboUIElement) ? descendant : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).EnterEditMode((EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)val);
				}
			}
			if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).IsInEditMode && ((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).CanFocus && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).Focus())
			{
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).ExitEditMode(false, true);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnKeyDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled && (int)DropDownStyle == 1 && ((Control)(object)this).IsInputKey(e.KeyData))
			{
				base.Owner.RaiseKeyDown(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyPress(KeyPressEventArgs e)

		}

		public bool DropDown()
		{
			Focus();
			if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).IsInEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)EditorWithCombo).DropDown();
			if (flag && Cursor.Current == null)
			{
				Cursor.Current = Cursors.Default;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(StringConverter))]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraDateTimeEditor_P_Value")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		[Bindable(BindableSupport.Yes)]
		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (controlValue == null || controlValue == DBNull.Value)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return DateTime;
			}
			set
			{
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).Value = value;
					controlValue = value;
					return;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				value = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).GetDataFilteredDestinationValue(value, (ConversionDirection)2, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)Owner, (object)this);
				if (object.Equals(value, controlValue))
				{
					return;
				}
				selectAllInGotFocus = true;
				if (value == null || value == DBNull.Value)
				{
					if (!Nullable)
					{
						throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_UltraDateTimeEditor_Exception_ValueNotNullable"));
					}
					controlValue = value;
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)54);
				}
				else
				{
					if (value is DateTime)
					{
						InternalSetDateTime((DateTime)value);
						controlValue = dateTime;
						((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)54);
					}
					if (value is string)
					{
						string text = value as string;
						if (text != null && text.Length == 0 && nullable)
						{
							Value = null;
							return;
						}
						DateTime newVal = dateTime;
						try
						{
							newVal = DateTime.Parse(text, FormatProvider);
						}
						catch
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							InternalSetDateTime(newVal);
							controlValue = dateTime;
							((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)54);
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					OnValueChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				if (mainElement != null)
				{
					mainElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraDateTimeEditor_P_DateTime")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		[Bindable(BindableSupport.Yes)]
		public DateTime DateTime
		{
			get
			{
				if ((controlValue == null || controlValue == DBNull.Value) && Nullable)
				{
					return MinDate;
				}
				return dateTime;
			}
			set
			{
				if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).Value = value;
				}
				if (dateTime != value || controlValue == null)
				{
					if (value < minDate || value > maxDate)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_5"));
					}
					InternalSetDateTime(value);
					controlValue = dateTime;
					if (mainElement != null)
					{
						mainElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
						((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
					}

		internal int NumberOfMaskPositionsInYearPortionOfMask
		{
			get
			{
				string text = ((MaskInput == null || MaskInput.Length <= 0) ? ((EditorWithMask)DateTimeEditor).CalcDefaultDateMask(FormatProvider) : MaskInput);
				if (text.IndexOf("yyyy") >= 0)
				{
					return 4;
				}
				if (text.IndexOf("yyy") >= 0)
				{
					return 3;
				}
				if (text.IndexOf("yy") >= 0)
				{
					return 2;
				}
				if (text.IndexOf("y") >= 0)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public UltraDateTimeEditor()
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00df: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			try
			{
				license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(UltraDateTimeEditor), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
			base.TabNavigation = DefaultTabNavigation;
			((Control)(object)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: true);
			minDate = defaultMinDate;
			maxDate = defaultMaxDate;
			dateTime = DefaultDateTime;
			controlValue = dateTime;
			mainElement = (UIElement)(object)new UltraDateTimeEditorUIElement(this);
			embeddableOwner = new DateTimeEditorOwner(this);
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).ValueChanged += ValueChangedEventHandler;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).BeforeDropDown += BeforeDropDownEventHandler;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).AfterCloseUp += AfterCloseUpEventHandler;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).AfterDropDown += AfterDropDownEventHandler;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).BeforeEnterEditMode += BeforeEnterEditModeEventHandler;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).BeforeExitEditMode += BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).AfterEnterEditMode += AfterEnterEditModeEventHandler;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).AfterExitEditMode += AfterExitEditModeEventHandler;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).KeyDown += EditorKeyDownEventHandler;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).KeyPress += EditorKeyPressEventHandler;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).KeyUp += EditorKeyUpEventHandler;

		}

		private void HookParentForm()
		{
			UnhookParentForm();
			if (!((Control)(object)this).Disposing && !((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed)
			{
				Form form = TextEditorControlBase.GetParentForm((Control)(object)this);
				if (form != null)
				{
					parentForm = form;
					form.Activated += OnFormActivate;
					form.Deactivate += OnFormDeactivate;
					form.Disposed += OnFormDisposed;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnhookParentForm()
		{
			if (parentForm != null)
			{
				parentForm.Activated -= OnFormActivate;
				parentForm.Deactivate -= OnFormDeactivate;
				parentForm.Disposed -= OnFormDisposed;
				parentForm = null;
			}
		}

					((SubObjectBase)(object)spinButtonIntervalSettings).SubObjectPropChanged -= OnSubObjectPropChanged;
					spinButtonIntervalSettings = null;
				}
				if (embeddableEditor != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)embeddableEditor).Disposed)

					((DisposableObject)(object)embeddableEditor).Dispose();

				if (embeddableEditorCopy != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)embeddableEditorCopy).Disposed)

				}
				if (!((DisposableObject)(object)mainElement).Disposed)

					((DisposableObject)(object)mainElement).Dispose();
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).PropertyChanged -= PropertyChangedHandler;
				propChangedEventHandler = null;

		}

		protected override void OnLeave(EventArgs e)

			((Control)(object)this).OnLeave(e);
		}

		private void AutoCorrectDate()
		{
			try
			{
				if (!(((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).IsInEditMode ? ((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).IsValid : wasDateValidWhenLastExitingEditMode))
				{
					object obj = DateTime.Today;
					DateTime newVal = DateTime.Today;
					switch (InvalidTextBehavior)
					{
					case InvalidTextBehavior.RevertToLastValidValue:
						obj = lastValidValue;
						break;
					case InvalidTextBehavior.RevertToOriginalValue:
						obj = lastOnEnterDate;
						break;
					case InvalidTextBehavior.PreserveWhileInEditMode:
						return;
					}
					if (obj is DateTime)
					{
						newVal = (DateTime)obj;
					}
					InternalSetDateTime(newVal);
					controlValue = obj;
					if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).IsInEditMode)
					{
						((EmbeddableEditorBase)DateTimeEditor).Value = controlValue;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void OnValidating(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).OnValidating(e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				AutoCorrectDate();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyMinMaxDate(ref DateTime? min, ref DateTime? max)
		{

				return;
			}

			{
				if (min.HasValue && min.Value < calendar.MinSupportedDateTime)
				{
					min = calendar.MinSupportedDateTime;
				}
				if (max.HasValue && max.Value > calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime)
				{
					max = calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ConvertStringToNumericValue(string stringVal, out object objectValue)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)NumericType == 2)
			{
				if (base.FormatProvider != null)
				{
					objectValue = decimal.Parse(stringVal, base.FormatProvider);
				}
				else
				{
					objectValue = decimal.Parse(stringVal);
				}
			}
			else if (base.FormatProvider != null)
			{
				objectValue = double.Parse(stringVal, base.FormatProvider);
			}
			else
			{
				objectValue = double.Parse(stringVal);
			}
			if (objectValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)NumericType == 0)
			{
				objectValue = Convert.ChangeType(objectValue, typeof(int));
			}
			if (objectValue == null)
			{

			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsValueWithinMinMaxRange(object val)
		{
			if (val == null || val == DBNull.Value)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (((EditorButtonControlBase)this).DataFilter != null && val.GetType() != typeof(int) && val.GetType() != typeof(double))
			{
				return true;
			}
			double num = Convert.ToDouble(InternalMinValue, base.FormatProvider);
			double num2 = Convert.ToDouble(InternalMaxValue, base.FormatProvider);
			double num3 = Convert.ToDouble(val, base.FormatProvider);
			IComparable comparable = num;
			IComparable comparable2 = num2;
			IComparable comparable3 = num3;
			if (comparable == null && comparable2 == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (comparable3.CompareTo(comparable) >= 0 && comparable3.CompareTo(comparable2) <= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void CreateEmbeddableEditorOwner()
		{
			embeddableOwner = new NumericEditorOwner(this);
		}

		internal int CompareValues(object arg1, object arg2)
		{
			IComparable comparable = arg1 as IComparable;
			IComparable comparable2 = arg2 as IComparable;
			if (comparable == null || comparable2 == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return comparable.CompareTo(comparable2);
		}

			//IL_0026: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			{
				return typeof(double);

		}

		protected override void OnEnter(EventArgs e)
		{
			if ((object)EmbeddableEditorBase.pendingCanceledEditModeControl == this)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase.pendingCanceledEditModeControl = null;
			}
			if (isValidating)
			{
				base.OnEnter(e);
				return;
			}
			UIElement descendant = mainElement.GetDescendant(typeof(EditorWithMaskEmbeddableUIElement));
			EditorWithMaskEmbeddableUIElement val = (EditorWithMaskEmbeddableUIElement)(object)((descendant is EditorWithMaskEmbeddableUIElement) ? descendant : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				Editor.EnterEditMode((EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)val);
			}
			else
			{
				mainElement.VerifyChildElements(true);
				UIElement descendant2 = mainElement.GetDescendant(typeof(EditorWithMaskEmbeddableUIElement));
				val = (EditorWithMaskEmbeddableUIElement)(object)((descendant2 is EditorWithMaskEmbeddableUIElement) ? descendant2 : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					Editor.EnterEditMode((EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)val);
				}
			}
			if (Editor.IsInEditMode && Editor.IsValid)
			{
				lastValidValue = editorValue;
			}
			base.OnEnter(e);
		}

		protected override void OnLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (isValidating || ignoreOnLeave)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).OnLeave(e);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (Editor.IsInEditMode)
			{
				string text = null;
				if (!Editor.IsValid)
				{
					ValidationErrorEventArgs e2 = ValidationFailedHelper();
					if (e2.RetainFocus)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					text = Editor.CurrentEditText;
				}
				if (!base.AlwaysInEditMode && !flag)
				{
					Editor.ExitEditMode(false, true);
				}
				if (text != null && !text.Equals(((Control)(object)this).Text))
				{
					((Control)(object)this).OnTextChanged(new EventArgs());
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				mainElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			lastValidValue = editorValue;
			((Control)(object)this).OnLeave(e);
			if (flag)
			{
				takeFocusTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
				takeFocusTimer.Tick += OnTakeFocusTimerTick;
				takeFocusTimer.Interval = 50;
				takeFocusTimer.Enabled = true;
				isValidating = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnTakeFocusTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (takeFocusTimer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			takeFocusTimer.Tick -= OnTakeFocusTimerTick;
			takeFocusTimer = null;
			try
			{
				Form form = TextEditorControlBase.GetParentForm((Control)(object)this);
				if (form != null && form == Form.ActiveForm)
				{
					((Control)(object)this).Focus();
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				isValidating = false;
			}
		}
