		protected override void OnValidating(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (takeFocusTimer != null && takeFocusTimer.Enabled)
			{
				if (takeFocusTimer != null)
				{
					if (isValidating)
					{
						isValidating = false;
					}
					takeFocusTimer.Stop();
				}
				e.Cancel = true;
				return;
			}
			if (Editor.IsInEditMode && !Editor.IsValid)
			{
				ValidationErrorEventArgs e2 = ValidationFailedHelper();
				if (e2.RetainFocus)
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
					return;
				}
			}
			((Control)(object)this).OnValidating(e);
		}

				return false;
			}
			((UIElement)UIElement).VerifyChildElements();

			EditorWithMaskEmbeddableUIElement val = (EditorWithMaskEmbeddableUIElement)(object)((descendant is EditorWithMaskEmbeddableUIElement) ? descendant : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Editor.EnterEditMode((EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)val);
		}

					break;
				case AccessibleEvents.Reorder:
					((Control)this).AccessibilityNotifyClients(eventId, 0);
					break;
				case AccessibleEvents.ValueChange:
					((Control)this).AccessibilityNotifyClients(eventId, AccessibleIndexCheckedItem);
					break;
				case AccessibleEvents.Focus:
					((Control)this).AccessibilityNotifyClients(eventId, AccessibleIndexFocusedItem);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void DirtyPreferredSize()
		{
			preferredSize = UninitializedSize;
			if (((Control)this).Created && ((Control)(object)this).AutoSize)
			{
				ApplyAutoSize();
			}
		}

		private void ApplyAutoSize()
		{
			if ((Image != null && !(Image is DBNull)) || DefaultImage != null)
			{
				((Control)this).Size = ((Control)this).PreferredSize;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnCreateControl()
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnCreateControl();
			SyncBackColor();
			if (((Control)(object)this).AutoSize)
			{
				ApplyAutoSize();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0088: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is UltraPictureBoxPropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((UltraPictureBoxPropertyIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case UltraPictureBoxPropertyIds.Image:
				case UltraPictureBoxPropertyIds.DrawBorderShadow:
				case UltraPictureBoxPropertyIds.BorderStyle:
				case UltraPictureBoxPropertyIds.BorderShadowDepth:
				case UltraPictureBoxPropertyIds.AutoSize:
				case UltraPictureBoxPropertyIds.Padding:
				case UltraPictureBoxPropertyIds.DefaultImage:
					DirtyPreferredSize();
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is UltraControlPropIds)
			{
				UltraControlPropIds val = (UltraControlPropIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId;
				if ((int)val == 5)
				{
					DirtyPreferredSize();
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		public override bool IsKeyMapped(Keys keyData, EmbeddableUIElementBase element)
		{
			if (keyData == Keys.Tab && control.AcceptsTab && control.Multiline)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (keyData)
			{
			case Keys.Tab:
			case Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift:
				return true;
			case Keys.Return:
				if (control.Multiline && control.AcceptsReturn)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			}
			if ((keyData & Keys.Space) == Keys.Space)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return control.InternalIsInputKey(keyData);
		}

					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_GETSEL:
					{
						int num2;
						int num3;
						if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)((EditorButtonControlBase)control).InternalEditor).SupportsSelectableText)
						{
							num2 = control.SelectionStart;
							num3 = num2 + control.SelectionLength;
						}
						else
						{
							num2 = 0;
							num3 = 0;
						}
						if (msg.WParam != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							Marshal.WriteInt32(msg.WParam, num2);
						}
						if (msg.LParam != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							Marshal.WriteInt32(msg.LParam, num3);
						}
						msg.Result = new IntPtr(num2 + (num3 << 16));
						return;
					}
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_SETSEL:
					{
						int num4 = (int)msg.WParam.ToInt64();
						int num5 = (int)msg.LParam.ToInt64();
						if (num4 == 0 && num5 == -1)
						{
							control.SelectAll();
							return;
						}
						if (num4 == -1)
						{
							control.SelectionLength = 0;
							return;
						}
						if (num4 > num5)
						{
							int num6 = num4;
							num4 = num5;
							num5 = num6;
						}
						control.SelectionStart = num4;
						control.SelectionLength = num5 - num4;
						return;
					}
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_REPLACESEL:
						if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)control.GetEditor()).IsInEditMode)
						{
							IntPtr lParam = msg.LParam;
							string selectedText = Marshal.PtrToStringAuto(lParam);
							control.SelectedText = selectedText;
						}
						return;
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_GETLINECOUNT:
						msg.Result = new IntPtr(1);
						return;
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_LINEFROMCHAR:
						msg.Result = new IntPtr(0);
						return;
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_LINEINDEX:
						if ((int)msg.WParam.ToInt64() != 0)
						{
							msg.Result = new IntPtr(-1);
						}
						else
						{
							msg.Result = IntPtr.Zero;
						}
						return;
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_LINELENGTH:
					{
						int num = (int)msg.WParam.ToInt64();
						int length = ((Control)(object)control).Text.Length;
						if (num > length)
						{
							msg.Result = IntPtr.Zero;
						}
						else if (num == -1)
						{
							msg.Result = new IntPtr(length - control.SelectionLength);
						}
						else
						{
							msg.Result = new IntPtr(length);
						}
						return;
					}
					}
				}
				base.WndProc(ref msg);
			}

			private void control_HandleCreated(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				((Control)(object)control).HandleCreated -= control_HandleCreated;
				AssignHandle(((Control)(object)control).Handle);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref Size proposedSize)
		{
			Size minimumSize = ((Control)(object)this).MinimumSize;
			Size maximumSize = ((Control)(object)this).MaximumSize;
			if (maximumSize.Width == 0)
			{
				maximumSize.Width = int.MaxValue;
			}
			if (maximumSize.Height == 0)
			{
				maximumSize.Height = int.MaxValue;
			}
			proposedSize.Width = Math.Max(minimumSize.Width, Math.Min(proposedSize.Width, maximumSize.Width));
			proposedSize.Height = Math.Max(minimumSize.Height, Math.Min(proposedSize.Height, maximumSize.Height));
		}

		private void LayoutToolStripOwningOverflow()
		{
			if (!(Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)this) is ToolStripOverflow obj))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				ReflectionPermission reflectionPermission = new ReflectionPermission(ReflectionPermissionFlag.MemberAccess);
				reflectionPermission.Assert();
				PropertyInfo property = typeof(ToolStripOverflow).GetProperty("ParentToolStrip", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
				if (!(property == null) && property.GetValue(obj, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, null, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) is ToolStrip toolStrip)
				{
					toolStrip.PerformLayout();
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldAutoSizeHeightWithZoom(out int height)
		{
			bool result = ShouldAutoSizeHeight(out height);
			if (((UltraControlBase)this).SupportsZooming)
			{
				height = (int)Math.Round(((UltraControlBase)this).ZoomFactor * (float)height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		}

		public override Size GetPreferredSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (proposedSize.Width == 0 || proposedSize.Width == 1)
			{
				proposedSize.Width = 2000000000;
				flag = false;
			}
			if (proposedSize.Height == 0 || proposedSize.Height == 1)
			{
				proposedSize.Height = 2000000000;
				flag2 = false;
			}
			ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref proposedSize);
			Size proposedSize2 = proposedSize;
			Control parent = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)this);
			if (!flag || parent is ToolStrip || parent is ToolStripOverflow)
			{
				proposedSize2.Width = ((Control)this).Width;
			}
			if (ShouldAutoSizeHeightWithZoom(out var height))
			{
				proposedSize2.Height = Math.Min(proposedSize2.Height, height);
			}
			else if (!flag2)
			{
				proposedSize2.Height = ((Control)this).Height;
			}
			ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref proposedSize2);
			return proposedSize2;
		}

		protected override void OnEnter(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (selectAllInGotFocus && !inMouseDown && ((EmbeddableEditorBase)((EditorButtonControlBase)this).InternalEditor).SupportsSelectableText)
			{
				SelectAll();
			}
			selectAllInGotFocus = false;
			((Control)this).OnEnter(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				inMouseDown = true;
				((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseDown(e);
			}
			finally
			{
				inMouseDown = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisibleChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnVisibleChanged(e);
			selectAllInGotFocus = true;
		}

		protected override void SetBoundsCore(int x, int y, int width, int height, BoundsSpecified specified)
		{
			if (ShouldAutoSizeHeightWithZoom(out var height2))
			{
				height = height2;
			}
			((Control)this).SetBoundsCore(x, y, width, height, specified);
		}

		protected override void OnHandleCreated(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (layoutToolStripOnHandleCreate)
			{
				((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)new MethodInvoker(LayoutToolStripOwningOverflow));
				layoutToolStripOnHandleCreate = false;
			}
			if (!((Control)this).RecreatingHandle)
			{
				CreateSubclasser();
			}
			((EditorButtonControlBase)this).OnHandleCreated(e);
		}

		protected override void OnParentChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			layoutToolStripOnHandleCreate = false;
			if (Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)this) is ToolStripOverflow)
			{
				if (((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
				{
					((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)new MethodInvoker(LayoutToolStripOwningOverflow));
				}
				else
				{
					layoutToolStripOnHandleCreate = true;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnParentChanged(e);
		}

		internal void ApplyCachedTextSelection(EmbeddableEditorBase editor, bool enteringEditMode)
		{
			if (editor != null && editor.SupportsSelectableText)
			{
				if (enteringEditMode && cachedSelectionStart >= 0 && cachedSelectionLength >= 0 && !inMouseDown)
				{
					editor.SelectionStart = cachedSelectionStart;
					editor.SelectionLength = cachedSelectionLength;
				}
				else
				{
					cachedSelectionStart = editor.SelectionStart;
					cachedSelectionLength = editor.SelectionLength;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateSubclasser()
		{
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				CreateSubclasserUnsafe();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void CreateSubclasserUnsafe()
		{
			nativeWindow = new UltraWinEditorMaskedControlBaseNativeWindow(this);
		}

		}

	internal static class EditorUtilities
	{
		static EditorUtilities()
		{
		}

		internal static bool FocusControl(Control control)
		{
			try
			{
				return control.Focus();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				try
				{
					if (control.CanFocus)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.SetFocusApi(control.Handle);
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			return control.Focused;
		}

		internal static bool AreValuesEqual(object val1, object val2)
		{
			if (val1 == null && val2 == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((val1 == null && val1 != null) || (val1 != null && val1 == null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(val1, val2))
			{
				return val1 == val2;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsActiveControl(Control control)
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				uIPermission.Assert();
				return Utilities.IsActiveControl(control);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsNullOrDBNull(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				return value == DBNull.Value;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class CalcDropDownHostButtonUIElement : ButtonUIElement
	{
		private CalcDropDownHostButtonType dropDownHostButtonType;

		private CalcDropDownHostUIElement CalcDropDownHostUIElement => ((UIElement)this).parentElement as CalcDropDownHostUIElement;

		public override UIRole UIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole(((UIElement)this).GetComponentRole(), (dropDownHostButtonType == CalcDropDownHostButtonType.OK) ? StyleUtils.Role.UltraCalculatorDropDownHostOkButton : StyleUtils.Role.UltraCalculatorDropDownHostCancelButton);

		public CalcDropDownHostButtonUIElement(CalcDropDownHostUIElement element, CalcDropDownHostButtonType type)
			: base((UIElement)(object)element)
		{
			dropDownHostButtonType = type;
		}

		protected override void InitControlAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags)
		{
			CalcDropDownHost calcDropDownHost = CalcDropDownHostUIElement.CalcDropDownHost;
			if (dropDownHostButtonType == CalcDropDownHostButtonType.OK)
			{
				if (calcDropDownHost.HasOkButtonAppearance)
				{
					calcDropDownHost.OKButtonAppearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
				}
			}
			else if (CalcDropDownHostButtonType.Cancel == dropDownHostButtonType && calcDropDownHost.HasCancelButtonAppearance)
			{
				calcDropDownHost.CancelButtonAppearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
			}
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).InitControlAppearance(ref appData, ref flags);
		}

		protected override void InitializeDefaultAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags)
		{
			if (dropDownHostButtonType == CalcDropDownHostButtonType.OK || CalcDropDownHostButtonType.Cancel == dropDownHostButtonType)
			{
				CalcDropDownHostUIElement.CalcDropDownHost.ResolveOkCancelAppearanceDefaults(ref appData, ref flags);
			}
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).InitializeDefaultAppearance(ref appData, ref flags);
		}
	}

		private void Control_SizeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(new Point(0, 0), ((Control)this).Size);
			rectangle.Inflate(-2, -2);
			rectangle.Offset(1, 0);
			if (showOKCancel)
			{
				((Control)(object)ultraCalculator).Location = rectangle.Location;
				Size size = rectangle.Size;
				size.Height -= (int)Math.Round((float)defaultButtonSpace * ((UltraControlBase)UltraCalculatorDropDown).ZoomFactor);
				((Control)(object)ultraCalculator).Size = size;
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)ultraCalculator).Location = rectangle.Location;
				((Control)(object)ultraCalculator).Size = rectangle.Size;
			}
		}

		public void ResolveCancelButtonAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (HasCancelButtonAppearance)
			{
				cancelButtonAppearanceHolder.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				if ((long)requestedProps == 0L)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ResolveOkCancelAppearanceDefaults(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
		}

		public void ResolveOkButtonAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (HasOkButtonAppearance)
			{
				oKButtonAppearanceHolder.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				if ((long)requestedProps == 0L)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ResolveOkCancelAppearanceDefaults(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal void ResolveOkCancelAppearanceDefaults(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)16))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)32))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFuL);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.Role.UltraCalculatorDropDownHost, out resOrder);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref flags, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref flags, (RoleState)1);
			}
		}

		internal void AttachToCalcDropDownEditor(CalcDropDownEditor editor)
		{
			calcDropDownEditor = editor;
		}

		internal void OKButtonPressed(object sender, UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			shouldCommitValue = true;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)calcDropDownEditor).CloseUp();
		}

		internal void CancelButtonPressed(object sender, UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			shouldCommitValue = false;
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)calcDropDownEditor).CloseUp();
		}

		internal void ResetControl()
		{
			shouldCommitValue = true;
		}

		internal bool ShouldCommitControlValue()
		{
			return shouldCommitValue;
		}

		private ButtonUIElement OKButtonElement

				if (okButtonElement == null)
				{
					okButtonElement = new CalcDropDownHostButtonUIElement(this, CalcDropDownHostButtonType.OK);
					((ButtonUIElementBase)okButtonElement).ElementClick += new UIElementEventHandler(CalcDropDownHost.OKButtonPressed);
					((ButtonWithTextUIElementBase)okButtonElement).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DropDownHostOK");
				}
				return (ButtonUIElement)(object)okButtonElement;
			}
		}

		private ButtonUIElement CancelButtonElement
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (cancelButtonElement == null)

					((ButtonUIElementBase)cancelButtonElement).ElementClick += new UIElementEventHandler(CalcDropDownHost.CancelButtonPressed);
					((ButtonWithTextUIElementBase)cancelButtonElement).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DropDownHostCancel");

		public CalcDropDownHostUIElement(CalcDropDownHost calcDropDownHost)
			: base((Control)(object)calcDropDownHost, (IUltraControl)(object)calcDropDownHost)
		{
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			if (CalcDropDownHost.ShowOKCancel)
			{
				Rectangle rectangleForZoomFactor = Utilities.GetRectangleForZoomFactor(((Control)(object)CalcDropDownHost.UltraCalculator).Bounds, 1f / ((ControlUIElementBase)this).ZoomFactor, false);
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(new Point(rectangleForZoomFactor.X + rectangleForZoomFactor.Width - CalcDropDownHost.DefaultButtonSize.Width, rectangleForZoomFactor.Y + rectangleForZoomFactor.Height + CalcDropDownHost.DefaultButtonVPad), CalcDropDownHost.DefaultButtonSize);
				((UIElement)CancelButtonElement).Rect = rect;
				rect.Offset(-(rect.Width + CalcDropDownHost.DefaultButtonHPad), 0);
				((UIElement)OKButtonElement).Rect = rect;
				if (rect.Left < ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Left)
				{
					rect.X = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Left + CalcDropDownHost.DefaultButtonHPad;
					rect.Width = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Width / 2 - CalcDropDownHost.DefaultButtonHPad * 2;
					((UIElement)OKButtonElement).Rect = rect;
					rect.Offset(rect.Width + CalcDropDownHost.DefaultButtonHPad, 0);
					((UIElement)CancelButtonElement).Rect = rect;
				}
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)OKButtonElement);
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)CancelButtonElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			CalcDropDownHost calcDropDownHost = CalcDropDownHost;
			calcDropDownHost.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			calcDropDownHost.UltraCalculator.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((ControlUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}
	}

	{
		private string decimalSymbol = ".";

		private bool autoDetectDecimalSymbol = true;

		private string groupSymbol = ",";

		private bool autoDetectGroupSymbol = true;

		private int groupSize = 3;

		private bool digitGrouping = true;

		private bool calculationPerformed;

		private ArrayList buttonArrayList;

		private CalculatorButton lastUsedPendingCalculationOperator = new CalculatorButton("", CalculatorButtonType.Operator);

		private CalculatorButton lastPendingValue = new CalculatorButton("", CalculatorButtonType.Numeric);

		private bool errorHasOccured;

		private string errorText = "";

		private const string MemoryValueButtonKey = "0";

		private CalculatorButton memoryValue = new CalculatorButton("0", CalculatorButtonType.Numeric);

		private int dummySignValue = 1;

		private CalculatorButton lastButtonPushed;

		public string GroupSymbol
		{
			get
			{
				if (autoDetectGroupSymbol)
				{
					return NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo.CurrencyGroupSeparator;
				}
				return groupSymbol;
			}
			set
			{
				groupSymbol = value;
			}
		}

		public bool AutoDetectGroupSymbol
		{
			get
			{
				return autoDetectGroupSymbol;
			}
			set
			{
				autoDetectGroupSymbol = value;
			}
		}

		public string DecimalSymbol
		{
			get
			{
				if (autoDetectDecimalSymbol)
				{
					return NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo.CurrencyDecimalSeparator;
				}
				return decimalSymbol;
			}
			set
			{
				decimalSymbol = value;
			}
		}

		public bool AutoDetectDecimalSymbol
		{
			get
			{
				return autoDetectDecimalSymbol;
			}
			set
			{
				autoDetectDecimalSymbol = value;
			}
		}

		public int GroupSize
		{
			get
			{
				return groupSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_UltraWinCalculator_GroupSize_Exception"));
				}
				groupSize = value;
			}
		}

		public string DisplayString
		{
			get
			{
				if (errorHasOccured)
				{
					return errorText;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < ButtonArrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (((CalculatorButton)ButtonArrayList[i]).Type == CalculatorButtonType.Numeric)
					{
						return FormatDisplayString(((CalculatorButton)ButtonArrayList[i]).Key);
					}
				}
				return "0" + DecimalSymbol;
			}
		}

		public bool DigitGrouping
		{
			get
			{
				return digitGrouping;
			}
			set
			{
				digitGrouping = value;
			}
		}

		public decimal DisplayValue
		{
			get
			{
				try
				{
					if (CurrentValue != null && CurrentValue.Key.Length > 0)
					{
						return decimal.Parse(CurrentValue.Key, FormatProvider);
					}
					return 0m;
				}
				catch
				{
					string text = ((CurrentValue != null) ? CurrentValue.Key : string.Empty);
					string text2 = ((PreviousValue != null) ? PreviousValue.Key : string.Empty);
					string operation = ((CurrentOperator != null) ? CurrentOperator.Key : string.Empty);
					FireCalculationFailEvent(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_UltraCalculator_Exception_UnableToConvertToDecimal"), new string[2] { text, text2 }, operation);
					return 0m;
				}
			}
		}

		public CalculatorButton MemoryValue
		{
			get
			{
				return memoryValue;
			}
			set
			{
				memoryValue = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasErrorOccurred => errorHasOccured;

		public bool HasMemoryValue
		{
			get
			{
				string value = ((memoryValue != null) ? memoryValue.Key : string.Empty);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					return !string.Equals(memoryValue.Key, "0");
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected CalculatorButton CurrentValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasCurrentValue)
				{
					return (CalculatorButton)ButtonArrayList[0];
				}
				return new CalculatorButton("0", CalculatorButtonType.Numeric);
			}
			set
			{
				if (HasCurrentValue)
				{
					ButtonArrayList[0] = value;
				}
				else
				{
					ButtonArrayList.Insert(0, value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected CalculatorButton CurrentOperator
		{
			get
			{
				if (ListHasOperator)
				{
					return (CalculatorButton)ButtonArrayList[1];
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!ListHasOperator)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < ButtonArrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (((CalculatorButton)ButtonArrayList[i]).Type == CalculatorButtonType.Operator)
					{
						ButtonArrayList[i] = value;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected CalculatorButton PreviousValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasPreviousValue)
				{
					return (CalculatorButton)ButtonArrayList[2];
				}
				return new CalculatorButton("0", CalculatorButtonType.Numeric);
			}
			set
			{
				if (HasCurrentValue)
				{
					ButtonArrayList[2] = value;
				}
				else
				{
					ButtonArrayList.Insert(2, value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool HasCurrentValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (ButtonArrayList.Count > 0 && ((CalculatorButton)ButtonArrayList[0]).Type == CalculatorButtonType.Numeric)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool HasPreviousValue
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < ButtonArrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (((CalculatorButton)ButtonArrayList[i]).Type == CalculatorButtonType.Numeric)
					{
						num++;
						if (num == 2)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool ListHasOperator
		{
			get
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ButtonArrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (((CalculatorButton)ButtonArrayList[i]).Type == CalculatorButtonType.Operator)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected ArrayList ButtonArrayList
		{
			get
			{
				if (buttonArrayList == null)
				{
					buttonArrayList = new ArrayList(3);
				}
				return buttonArrayList;
			}
		}

		private bool HasLastPendingOperators
		{
			get
			{
				if (lastPendingValue.Key != "" && lastUsedPendingCalculationOperator.Key != "")
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsCurrentValueAtMax
		{
			get
			{
				if (CurrentValue.Key.Length >= 32)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldClearExistingText
		{
			get
			{
				if (lastButtonPushed == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (lastButtonPushed.Key)
				{
				case "=":
				case "MS":
				case "MC":
				case "MR":
				case "M+":
				case "sqrt":
				case "%":
				case "1/x":
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal IFormatProvider FormatProvider => CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

		public event BeforeButtonClickedEventHandler BeforeButtonClicked;

		public event EventHandler AfterCalculationComplete;

		public event BeforeCalculatePendingEventHandler BeforeCalculatePending;

		public event EventHandler AfterCalculatePending;

		public event BeforeCalculateImmediateEventHandler BeforeCalculateImmediate;

		public event EventHandler AfterCalculateImmediate;

		public event BeforeDefaultCalculationFailEventHandler DefaultCalculationFail;

		public event BeforeCalculateImmediateEventHandler BeforeActionButtonPressed;

		public event EventHandler AfterActionButtonPressed;

		public event CalculatorButtonEventHandler AfterButtonClicked;

		public bool ShouldSerializeAutoDetectDecimalSymbol()
		{
			return !autoDetectDecimalSymbol;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeAutoDetectGroupSymbol()
		{
			return !autoDetectGroupSymbol;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeDigitGrouping()
		{
			return !digitGrouping;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeGroupSize()
		{
			return groupSize != 3;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeDecimalSymbol()
		{
			if (!autoDetectDecimalSymbol)
			{
				if (CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.GetFormat(typeof(NumberFormatInfo)) is NumberFormatInfo numberFormatInfo)
				{
					return decimalSymbol != numberFormatInfo.NumberDecimalSeparator;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeGroupSymbol()
		{
			if (!autoDetectGroupSymbol)
			{
				if (CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.GetFormat(typeof(NumberFormatInfo)) is NumberFormatInfo numberFormatInfo)
				{
					return groupSymbol != numberFormatInfo.NumberGroupSeparator;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetDigitGrouping()
		{
			digitGrouping = true;
		}

		public void ResetAutoDetectDecimalSymbol()
		{
			autoDetectDecimalSymbol = true;
		}

		public void ResetAutoDetectGroupSymbol()
		{
			autoDetectGroupSymbol = true;
		}

		public void ResetGroupSize()
		{
			groupSize = 3;
		}

		public void ResetDecimalSymbol()
		{
			NumberFormatInfo numberFormatInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.GetFormat(typeof(NumberFormatInfo)) as NumberFormatInfo;
			decimalSymbol = ((numberFormatInfo == null) ? "." : numberFormatInfo.NumberDecimalSeparator);
		}

		public void ResetGroupSymbol()
		{
			NumberFormatInfo numberFormatInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.GetFormat(typeof(NumberFormatInfo)) as NumberFormatInfo;
			groupSymbol = ((numberFormatInfo == null) ? "." : numberFormatInfo.NumberGroupSeparator);
		}

		public void ClearEntry()
		{
			if (HasCurrentValue)
			{
				if (errorHasOccured)
				{
					ClearAll();
				}
				CurrentValue.Key = "0";
			}
			dummySignValue = 1;
		}

		public void BackSpace()
		{
			if (!HasCurrentValue || CurrentValue.Key.Length <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (CurrentValue.Key.Length == 1)
			{
				CurrentValue.Key = "0";
				return;
			}
			if (CurrentValue.Key[CurrentValue.Key.Length - 1] == '.')
			{
				CurrentValue.Key = CurrentValue.Key.Substring(0, CurrentValue.Key.Length - 2);
				return;
			}
			CurrentValue.Key = CurrentValue.Key.Substring(0, CurrentValue.Key.Length - 1);
			if (CurrentValue.Key.Length == 1 && !char.IsNumber(CurrentValue.Key, 0))
			{
				CurrentValue.Key = "0";
				dummySignValue = 1;
			}
		}

		public void ClearAll()
		{
			errorHasOccured = false;
			ButtonArrayList.Clear();
			ResetLastPendingOperators();
			dummySignValue = 1;
		}

		public void MemoryAdd()
		{
			if (!HasCurrentValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			try
			{
				decimal num = decimal.Parse(CurrentValue.Key, FormatProvider);
				num = decimal.Parse(MemoryValue.Key, FormatProvider);
			}
			catch
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			try
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					decimal number = default(decimal);
					if (CurrentValue != null && CurrentValue.Key != "")
					{
						number = decimal.Parse(CurrentValue.Key, FormatProvider);
					}
					MemoryAdd(number);
				}
				else
				{
					double num2 = double.Parse(CurrentValue.Key, FormatProvider);
					double num3 = ((MemoryValue.Key == null || MemoryValue.Key.Length == 0) ? 0.0 : double.Parse(MemoryValue.Key, FormatProvider));
					MemoryValue.Key = (num3 + num2).ToString();
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				string text = ((CurrentValue != null) ? CurrentValue.Key : string.Empty);
				string text2 = ((PreviousValue != null) ? PreviousValue.Key : string.Empty);
				string operation = ((CurrentOperator != null) ? CurrentOperator.Key : string.Empty);
				FireCalculationFailEvent(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_UltraCalculator_Exception_UnableToConvertToDecimal"), new string[2] { text, text2 }, operation);
			}
		}

		public void MemoryAdd(decimal number)
		{
			try
			{
				decimal num = default(decimal);
				if (MemoryValue.Key != "")
				{
					num = decimal.Parse(MemoryValue.Key, FormatProvider);
				}
				num += number;
				MemoryValue.Key = num.ToString();
			}
			catch
			{
				string text = ((CurrentValue != null) ? CurrentValue.Key : string.Empty);
				string text2 = ((PreviousValue != null) ? PreviousValue.Key : string.Empty);
				string operation = ((CurrentOperator != null) ? CurrentOperator.Key : string.Empty);
				FireCalculationFailEvent(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_UltraCalculator_Exception_UnableToConvertToDecimal"), new string[2] { text, text2 }, operation);
			}
		}

		public void MemoryClear()
		{
			memoryValue.Key = "0";
		}

		public void MemoryStore()
		{
			if (HasCurrentValue)
			{
				memoryValue.Key = (string)CurrentValue.Key.Clone();
			}
		}

		public void MemoryStore(decimal number)
		{
			memoryValue.Key = number.ToString();
		}

		public void MemoryStore(string stringValue)
		{
			memoryValue.Key = stringValue;
		}

		public void MemoryRecall()
		{
			if (HasCurrentValue)
			{
				CurrentValue.Key = (string)memoryValue.Key.Clone();
			}
			else
			{
				CurrentValue = new CalculatorButton(memoryValue.Key, CalculatorButtonType.Numeric);
			}
		}

		public void PushButton(CalculatorButton calcButton)
		{
			OnBeforeButtonClickedEventArgs e = new OnBeforeButtonClickedEventArgs(calcButton);
			OnBeforeButtonClicked(this, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				CalculatorButton calculatorButton = new CalculatorButton(e.Button.Key, e.Button.Type);
				if (errorHasOccured && calculatorButton.Type != CalculatorButtonType.ActionButton)
				{
					return;
				}
				switch (calculatorButton.Type)
				{
				case CalculatorButtonType.Numeric:
					if (ShouldClearExistingText)
					{
						ResetLastPendingOperators();
						ButtonArrayList.Clear();
					}
					if (!IsStringNumeric(calculatorButton.Key) && !(calculatorButton.Key == "."))
					{
						break;
					}
					if (HasCurrentValue)
					{
						if (CurrentValue.Key.Length > 1 && CurrentValue.Key[0].ToString() == "0" && Strings.InStr(CurrentValue.Key, ".", CompareMethod.Text) == 0)
						{
							CurrentValue.Key = CurrentValue.Key.Substring(1);
						}
						if ((calculatorButton.Key == "." && CurrentValue.Key.IndexOf(".") > -1) || (calculatorButton.Key == "0" && CurrentValue.Key.IndexOf("0") == 0 && CurrentValue.Key.IndexOf(".") == -1 && CurrentValue.Key.IndexOf("0") > -1))
						{
							return;
						}
						if (IsCurrentValueAtMax)
						{
							SystemSounds.Beep.Play();
						}
						else
						{
							CurrentValue.Key += calculatorButton.Key;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ButtonArrayList.Insert(0, calculatorButton);
					}
					break;
				case CalculatorButtonType.ActionButton:
					PerformActionButton(calculatorButton);
					break;
				case CalculatorButtonType.Operator:
					dummySignValue = 1;
					if (HasCurrentValue && ListHasOperator && HasPreviousValue)
					{
						PerformPendingCalculations();
					}
					else if (ListHasOperator)
					{
						CurrentOperator = calculatorButton;
						return;
					}
					if (HasCurrentValue)
					{
						ButtonArrayList.Insert(0, calculatorButton);
					}
					ResetLastPendingOperators();
					break;
				case CalculatorButtonType.OperatorImmediateAction:
					if (calculatorButton != null)
					{
						if (calculatorButton.Key == "")
						{
							calculatorButton.Key = "0";
						}
						PerformImmediateCalculation(calculatorButton.Key);
					}
					ResetLastPendingOperators();
					break;
				case CalculatorButtonType.OperatorPerformImmediateThenPendingCalculations:
					if (calculatorButton != null)
					{
						if (calculatorButton.Key == "")
						{
							calculatorButton.Key = "0";
						}
						PerformImmediateCalculation(calculatorButton.Key);
						if (ListHasOperator)
						{
							PerformPendingCalculations();
						}
					}
					ResetLastPendingOperators();
					break;
				case CalculatorButtonType.OperatorPerformPendingCalculations:
					dummySignValue = 1;
					if (ListHasOperator)
					{
						if (HasCurrentValue && IsStringNumeric(CurrentValue.Key) && ListHasOperator)
						{
							lastPendingValue = CurrentValue;
							lastUsedPendingCalculationOperator = CurrentOperator;
						}
						PerformPendingCalculations();
					}
					else if (HasLastPendingOperators)
					{
						ButtonArrayList.Insert(0, lastUsedPendingCalculationOperator);
						ButtonArrayList.Insert(0, lastPendingValue);
						PerformPendingCalculations();
					}
					break;
				}
				if (calculationPerformed)
				{
					OnAfterCalculationComplete(this, new EventArgs());
				}
				calculationPerformed = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				lastButtonPushed = calcButton;
				OnAfterButtonClicked(new CalculatorButtonEventArgs(calcButton));
			}
		}

		protected bool IsStringNumeric(string number)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < number.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!char.IsNumber(number, i) && number[i] != '.' && number[i] != '-' && number[i] != '+' && number[i] != 'E')
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual string FormatDisplayString(string displayText)
		{
			if (IsStringNumeric(displayText))
			{
				int num = displayText.IndexOf(".");
				if (displayText == "")
				{
					displayText = "0" + DecimalSymbol;
				}
				else
				{
					switch (num)
					{
					case -1:
						displayText += DecimalSymbol;
						break;
					case 0:
						displayText = displayText.Insert(0, "0");
						break;
					}
				}
				displayText = displayText.Replace(".", DecimalSymbol);
				num = displayText.IndexOf(DecimalSymbol);
				if (GroupSize > 0)
				{
					if (DigitGrouping && displayText.Length > GroupSize + (displayText.Length - num))
					{
						for (int num2 = displayText.Length - (displayText.Length - num) - GroupSize; num2 > 0; num2 -= GroupSize)
						{
							displayText = displayText.Insert(num2, GroupSymbol);
						}
					}
					if (displayText.Length > 2 && (displayText[0] == '+' || displayText[0] == '-') && displayText[1].ToString() == GroupSymbol)
					{
						displayText = displayText[0] + displayText.Substring(2);
					}
				}
				try
				{
					string negativeSign = NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo.NegativeSign;
					decimal num3 = decimal.Parse(CurrentValue.Key, FormatProvider);
					if (dummySignValue < 1 && Strings.InStr(displayText, negativeSign, CompareMethod.Text) == 0)
					{
						displayText = negativeSign + displayText;
						CurrentValue.Key = negativeSign + CurrentValue.Key;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return displayText;
		}

		protected void FireCalculationFailEvent(string errorMessage, string[] values, string operation)
		{
			errorHasOccured = true;
			OnDefaultCalculationFailEventArgs e = new OnDefaultCalculationFailEventArgs(errorMessage, values, operation);
			OnDefaultCalculationFail(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				errorText = e.ErrMsg;
			}
			else
			{
				errorHasOccured = false;
			}
		}

		private void PerformActionButton(CalculatorButton button)
		{
			OnCalculateImmediateEventArgs e = new OnCalculateImmediateEventArgs(CurrentValue.Key, button.Key);
			OnBeforeActionButtonPressed(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				if (!errorHasOccured)
				{
					CurrentValue.Key = e.CurrentValue;
					if (button.Key == "M+")
					{
						MemoryAdd();
					}
					else if (button.Key == "MS")
					{
						MemoryStore();
					}
				}
				if (button.Key == "MR")
				{
					MemoryRecall();
				}
				else if (button.Key == "MC")
				{
					MemoryClear();
				}
				else if (button.Key == "Backspace")
				{
					BackSpace();
				}
				else if (button.Key == "C")
				{
					ClearAll();
				}
				else if (button.Key == "CE")
				{
					ClearEntry();
				}
				OnAfterActionButtonPressed(this, new EventArgs());
			}
			else if (e.CurrentValue != CurrentValue.Key)
			{
				CurrentValue.Key = e.CurrentValue;
				OnAfterActionButtonPressed(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		private void PerformPendingCalculations()
		{
			if (!ListHasOperator || !HasCurrentValue || !HasPreviousValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			try
			{
				decimal num = decimal.Parse(CurrentValue.Key, FormatProvider);
				decimal num2 = decimal.Parse(PreviousValue.Key, FormatProvider);
			}
			catch
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (PreviousValue.Key == "")
			{
				PreviousValue.Key = "0";
			}
			if (CurrentValue.Key == "")
			{
				CurrentValue.Key = "0";
			}
			OnCalculatePendingEventArgs e = new OnCalculatePendingEventArgs(CurrentValue.Key, PreviousValue.Key, CurrentOperator.Key);
			OnBeforeCalculatePending(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				try
				{
					if (IsStringNumeric(e.CurrentValue) && IsStringNumeric(e.PreviousValue))
					{
						try
						{
							object obj2 = null;
							object obj3 = null;
							if (flag)
							{
								obj2 = decimal.Parse(e.CurrentValue, FormatProvider);
								obj3 = decimal.Parse(e.PreviousValue, FormatProvider);
							}
							else
							{
								obj2 = double.Parse(e.CurrentValue, FormatProvider);
								obj3 = double.Parse(e.PreviousValue, FormatProvider);
							}
							switch (CurrentOperator.Key)
							{
							case "/":
								obj2 = ((!flag) ? ((object)((double)obj3 / (double)obj2)) : ((object)((decimal)obj3 / (decimal)obj2)));
								break;
							case "*":
								obj2 = ((!flag) ? ((object)((double)obj3 * (double)obj2)) : ((object)((decimal)obj3 * (decimal)obj2)));
								break;
							case "-":
								obj2 = ((!flag) ? ((object)((double)obj3 - (double)obj2)) : ((object)((decimal)obj3 - (decimal)obj2)));
								break;
							case "+":
								obj2 = ((!flag) ? ((object)((double)obj3 + (double)obj2)) : ((object)((decimal)obj3 + (decimal)obj2)));
								break;
							}
							ButtonArrayList.Clear();
							string buttonKey = (flag ? ((decimal)obj2).ToString(FormatProvider) : ((double)obj2).ToString(FormatProvider));
							CalculatorButton value = new CalculatorButton(buttonKey, CalculatorButtonType.Numeric);
							ButtonArrayList.Insert(0, value);
							calculationPerformed = true;
							OnAfterCalculatePending(this, new EventArgs());
							return;
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							string text = ((CurrentValue != null) ? CurrentValue.Key : string.Empty);
							string text2 = ((PreviousValue != null) ? PreviousValue.Key : string.Empty);
							string operation = ((CurrentOperator != null) ? CurrentOperator.Key : string.Empty);
							FireCalculationFailEvent(ex.Message, new string[2] { text, text2 }, operation);
							return;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					string text3 = ((CurrentValue != null) ? CurrentValue.Key : string.Empty);
					string text4 = ((PreviousValue != null) ? PreviousValue.Key : string.Empty);
					string operation2 = ((CurrentOperator != null) ? CurrentOperator.Key : string.Empty);
					FireCalculationFailEvent(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_UltraCalculator_Exception_UnableToConvertToDecimal"), new string[2] { text3, text4 }, operation2);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (e.CurrentValue != CurrentValue.Key)
			{
				ButtonArrayList.Clear();
				CalculatorButton value2 = new CalculatorButton(e.CurrentValue, CalculatorButtonType.Numeric);
				ButtonArrayList.Insert(0, value2);
				calculationPerformed = true;
				OnAfterCalculatePending(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		private void PerformImmediateCalculation(string operation)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (!HasCurrentValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			OnCalculateImmediateEventArgs e = new OnCalculateImmediateEventArgs(CurrentValue.Key, operation);
			OnBeforeCalculateImmediate(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				bool flag3 = true;
				string text = e.CurrentValue;
				if (text != null && text.Trim() == DecimalSymbol)
				{
					text = "0";
				}
				try
				{
					decimal num = decimal.Parse(text, FormatProvider);
					if (operation == "1/x")
					{
						num = 1m / num;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					flag3 = false;
					if (ex is DivideByZeroException)
					{
						double num2 = double.Parse(CurrentValue.Key, FormatProvider);
						if (num2 != 0.0)
						{
							flag3 = false;
						}
					}
				}
				try
				{
					if (!IsStringNumeric(e.CurrentValue))
					{
						return;
					}
					object obj = null;
					obj = ((!flag3) ? ((object)double.Parse(text, FormatProvider)) : ((object)decimal.Parse(text, FormatProvider)));
					switch (operation)
					{
					case "sqrt":
						try
						{
							double d = double.Parse(e.CurrentValue, FormatProvider);
							d = Math.Sqrt(d);
							obj = ((!flag3) ? ((object)d) : ((object)(decimal)d));
						}
						catch (Exception ex2)
						{
							string text2 = ((CurrentValue != null) ? CurrentValue.Key : string.Empty);
							string text3 = ((PreviousValue != null) ? PreviousValue.Key : string.Empty);
							string operation2 = ((CurrentOperator != null) ? CurrentOperator.Key : string.Empty);
							FireCalculationFailEvent(ex2.Message, new string[2] { text2, text3 }, operation2);
						}
						break;
					case "%":
						if (flag3)
						{
							try
							{
								decimal num3 = Convert.ToDecimal(PreviousValue.Key, FormatProvider);
								decimal num4 = (decimal)obj * 0.01m;
								obj = num3 * num4;
							}
							catch
							{
								obj = 0m;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							try
							{
								double num5 = Convert.ToDouble(PreviousValue.Key, FormatProvider);
								double num6 = (double)obj * 0.01;
								obj = num5 * num6;
							}
							catch
							{
								obj = 0.0;
							}
						}
						break;
					case "1/x":
						try
						{
							obj = ((!flag3) ? ((object)(1.0 / (double)obj)) : ((object)(1m / (decimal)obj)));
						}
						catch
						{
							flag3 = false;
							obj = double.Parse(e.CurrentValue, FormatProvider);
							obj = 1.0 / (double)obj;
						}
						break;
					case "+/-":
					{
						dummySignValue *= -1;
						bool flag4 = false;
						if ((!flag3) ? ((double)obj == 0.0) : ((decimal)obj == 0m))
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						obj = ((!flag3) ? ((object)((double)obj * -1.0)) : ((object)((decimal)obj * -1m)));
						break;
					}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						if (flag3)
						{
							dummySignValue = (((decimal)obj == 0m) ? 1 : dummySignValue);
							CurrentValue.Key = ((decimal)obj).ToString(FormatProvider);
						}
						else
						{
							dummySignValue = (((double)obj == 0.0) ? 1 : dummySignValue);
							CurrentValue.Key = ((double)obj).ToString(FormatProvider);
						}
					}
					else if (dummySignValue > 0)
					{
						CurrentValue.Key = CurrentValue.Key.Replace("-", string.Empty);
					}
					calculationPerformed = true;
					OnAfterCalculateImmediate(this, new EventArgs());
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception ex3)
				{
					string text4 = ((CurrentValue != null) ? CurrentValue.Key : string.Empty);
					string text5 = ((PreviousValue != null) ? PreviousValue.Key : string.Empty);
					string operation3 = ((CurrentOperator != null) ? CurrentOperator.Key : string.Empty);
					FireCalculationFailEvent(ex3.Message, new string[2] { text4, text5 }, operation3);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (e.CurrentValue != CurrentValue.Key)
			{
				CurrentValue.Key = e.CurrentValue;
				calculationPerformed = true;
				OnAfterCalculateImmediate(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		internal bool HandleParseError(string invalidText, out string errorMessage)
		{
			string text = ((CurrentValue != null) ? CurrentValue.Key : string.Empty);
			string text2 = ((PreviousValue != null) ? PreviousValue.Key : string.Empty);
			string operation = ((CurrentOperator != null) ? CurrentOperator.Key : string.Empty);
			FireCalculationFailEvent(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_UltraCalculator_Exception_UnableToParse", invalidText), new string[2] { text, text2 }, operation);
			errorMessage = errorText;
			return errorHasOccured;
		}

		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_0"));
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is CalculatorButton)
				{
					CalculatorButton calculatorButton = (CalculatorButton)value;
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(CalculatorButton).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(int) });
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { calculatorButton.Index }, isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		public class CalculatorButtonAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private CalculatorButton button;

			public CalculatorButton Button => button;

			public UltraCalculator Calculator
			{
				get
				{
					if (!(Button.PrimaryCollection is CalculatorButtonCollection calculatorButtonCollection))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return calculatorButtonCollection.Control;
				}
			}

			public UIElement UIElement
			{
				get
				{
					UltraCalculator calculator = Calculator;
					if (calculator != null && !((Control)(object)calculator).IsDisposed)
					{
						return calculator.UIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(CalculatorButtonUIElement), (object)Button);
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => ((Control)(object)Calculator)?.AccessibilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.PushButton;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string text = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (text == null)
					{
						text = ((Button.AccessibleName == null) ? Utilities.StripMnemonics(Button.Text) : Button.AccessibleName);
					}
					return text;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override string KeyboardShortcut => Utilities.GetLocalizedKeyString(Button.KeyCode);

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					CalculatorButton calculatorButton = Button;
					UIElement val = null;
					UltraCalculator calculator = Calculator;
					if (!calculatorButton.Visible || (calculator != null && !calculator.IsButtonVisible(calculatorButton)))
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					else
					{
						val = UIElement;
						if (val == null || val.ClipRect.IsEmpty)
						{
							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
						}
					}
					if (val != null && !val.Enabled)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					else if ((accessibleStates & AccessibleStates.Invisible) != AccessibleStates.None)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					else
					{
						ButtonUIElementBase val2 = (ButtonUIElementBase)(object)((val is ButtonUIElementBase) ? val : null);
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							if (val2.IsMouseDownAndOver)
							{
								accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Pressed;
							}
							else if (val2.IsMouseOver)
							{
								accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.HotTracked;
							}
						}
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleActionCalculatorButtonPush");

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
					Control control = ((uIElement == null) ? null : uIElement.Control);
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
					{
						return control.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.Rect);
					}
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

			public CalculatorButtonAccessibleObject(CalculatorButton button)
			{
				this.button = button;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return (Control)(object)Calculator;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				Calculator?.PushButton(Button);
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return 0;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					if (Calculator != null)
					{
						return Calculator.NavigateChildren(navdir, Button);
					}
					return null;
				default:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Navigate(navdir);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearance(CalculatorButtonUIElement element, ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder((UltraControlBase)(object)element?.UltraCalculator);
			UIRole val = ((element != null) ? ((UIElement)element).UIRole : null);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && val != null)
			{
				val.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (HasAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				appearanceHolder.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				if ((long)requestedProps == 0L)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				element.UltraCalculator.ResolveButtonAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, resolveDefaults: false);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && val != null)
			{
				val.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			element.UltraCalculator.ResolveButtonAppearanceDefaults(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)2))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ForeColor = GetBasicInitInfoFromIndex(Index).ForeColor;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x10uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)16))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)32))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFuL);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveHotTrackingAppearance(CalculatorButtonUIElement element, ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder((UltraControlBase)(object)element?.UltraCalculator);
			UIRole val = ((element != null) ? ((UIElement)element).UIRole : null);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && val != null)
			{
				val.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4);
			}
			if (HasHotTrackingAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				hotTrackingAppearanceHolder.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				if ((long)requestedProps == 0L)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			element.UltraCalculator.ResolveHotTrackingAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && val != null)
			{
				val.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4);
			}
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(UltraCalculatorButtonCollectionConverter))]
	public class CalculatorButtonCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, IEnumerable
	{
		public class SerializableButtonsCollectionEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private int index = -1;

			private CalculatorButtonCollection calculatorButtonCollection;

			object IEnumerator.Current => calculatorButtonCollection.GetItem(index);

			public CalculatorButton Current => calculatorButtonCollection.GetItem(index) as CalculatorButton;

			public SerializableButtonsCollectionEnumerator(CalculatorButtonCollection calcButtonCollection)
			{
				if (calcButtonCollection == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				calculatorButtonCollection = calcButtonCollection;
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				int num = index;
				while (num < calculatorButtonCollection.Count)
				{
					num++;
					if (num >= calculatorButtonCollection.Count)
					{
						break;
					}
					CalculatorButton calculatorButton = (CalculatorButton)calculatorButtonCollection.GetItem(num);
					if (calculatorButton.ButtonShouldSerialize)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num < calculatorButtonCollection.Count)
				{
					index = num;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				index = -1;
			}
		}

		private UltraCalculator owningControl;

		private static readonly int MAX_BASIC_BUTTON_COUNT = 35;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

		protected override int InitialCapacity => MAX_BASIC_BUTTON_COUNT;

		internal UltraCalculator Control => owningControl;

		public CalculatorButton this[int index] => (CalculatorButton)GetItem(index);

		public CalculatorButton this[string key] => (CalculatorButton)GetItem(key);

		internal CalculatorButtonCollection(UltraCalculator owningControl)
		{
			this.owningControl = owningControl;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (owningControl.UltraCalculatorDropDown == null)
			{
				if (owningControl.IsDesignMode)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			else if (owningControl.UltraCalculatorDropDown.IsDesignMode)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return new SerializableButtonsCollectionEnumerator(this);
			}
			return new DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase(this);
		}

		public void AddRange(CalculatorButton[] buttons)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i <= buttons.GetUpperBound(0); i++)
			{
				int index = buttons[i].Index;
				if (owningControl.CalculatorStyle != CalculatorStyle.Basic || index >= MAX_BASIC_BUTTON_COUNT)
				{
					continue;
				}
				buttons[i].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (index != -1)
				{
					CalculatorButton calculatorButton = this[index];
					if (calculatorButton != null)
					{
						calculatorButton.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					InternalRemoveAt(index);
					InternalInsert(index, buttons[i]);
				}
				else
				{
					InternalAdd(buttons[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal CalculatorButton Add(CalculatorButtonInitializationInfo info, bool visible)
		{
			return Add(info.Text, info.Text, visible, info.Type, info.KeyCode, info.SecondaryKeyCode);
		}

		internal CalculatorButton Add(string keyText, string DisplayText, bool Visible, CalculatorButtonType type, Keys keyCode, Keys keyCodeAlternate)
		{
			CalculatorButton calculatorButton = new CalculatorButton(Visible, DisplayText, List.Count, type, keyCode, keyCodeAlternate);
			calculatorButton.Key = keyText;
			calculatorButton.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalAdd(calculatorButton);
			return calculatorButton;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)0, propChange);
		}
	}

		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection result = null;
			if (value is CalculatorButtonCollection { Count: >0 } calculatorButtonCollection)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[calculatorButtonCollection.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < calculatorButtonCollection.Count; i++)

					string name = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_CalculatorButton_PropertyDescriptorName") + "[" + calculatorButton.Index.ToString("d2") + "]";
					array[i] = new UltraCalculatorCollectionPropertyDescriptor(calculatorButton, name, calculatorButtonCollection);
				}
				result = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
			}
			return result;
		}

			UIRole uIRole = ((UIElement)this).UIRole;
			if (((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsPressed && (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore || ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter) && uIRole != null)

			((ButtonWithTextUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

	public class CalcDropDownEditor : EditorWithTextAndDropDownBase, IEmbeddableTextBoxListener
	{
		private UltraCalculatorDropDown ultraCalculatorDropDown;

		private bool lastKeyDownCausedCloseUp;

		private bool createdDropdownControl;

		internal const string AppStylingSharedObjectName = "CalcDropDownEditor";

		protected override bool ShouldCommitControlToDropValue => UltraCalculatorDropDown.CalcDropDownHost.ShouldCommitControlValue();

		public override object Value
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).IsInEditMode)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_15"));
				}
				string text = null;
				bool flag = default(bool);
				object dataFilteredDestinationValue = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).GetDataFilteredDestinationValue((ConversionDirection)3, ref flag, ((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).ElementBeingEdited.Owner, ((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).ElementBeingEdited.OwnerContext, ref text);
				if (!flag)
				{
					if ((((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).DataFilter == null || (int)((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).CanHandleConversionInternal((ConversionDirection)3) != 1) && ((EditorWithText)this).EditorValue != null)
					{
						return ((EditorWithText)this).EditorValue;
					}
					if (text == null)
					{
						throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_Exception_140"));
					}
					throw new Exception(text);
				}
				return dataFilteredDestinationValue;
			}
			set
			{
				((EditorWithText)this).Value = value;
			}
		}

		protected override Control ControlToDrop => (Control)(object)UltraCalculatorDropDown.CalcDropDownHost;

		protected override object ControlToDropValue => Calculator.DisplayValue;

		protected UltraCalculatorDropDown UltraCalculatorDropDown => ultraCalculatorDropDown;

		protected UltraCalculator Calculator => UltraCalculatorDropDown.CalcDropDownHost.UltraCalculator;

		public CalcDropDownEditor()
		{
			ultraCalculatorDropDown = new UltraCalculatorDropDown();
			createdDropdownControl = true;
		}

		public CalcDropDownEditor(UltraCalculatorDropDown control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_CalcDropDownEditor_ControlParameterCannotBeNull"));
			}
			ultraCalculatorDropDown = control;
		}

		public CalcDropDownEditor(EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase defaultOwner, UltraCalculatorDropDown control)
			: base(defaultOwner)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_CalcDropDownEditor_ControlParameterCannotBeNull"));
			}
			ultraCalculatorDropDown = control;
		}

		protected override EditorWithTextAndDropDownUIElementBase CreateEmbeddableUIElement(UIElement parentElement, EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase owner, object ownerContext, bool includeEditElements, bool reserveSpaceForEditElements, bool drawOuterBorders, bool isToolTip)
		{
			return (EditorWithTextAndDropDownUIElementBase)(object)new EmbeddableCalcDropDownUIElement(parentElement, owner, (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)this, ownerContext, includeEditElements, reserveSpaceForEditElements, drawOuterBorders, isToolTip);
		}

		protected override bool DoDropDown()
		{
			UltraCalculatorDropDown.CalcDropDownHost.AttachToCalcDropDownEditor(this);
			return ((EditorWithTextAndDropDownBase)this).DoDropDown();
		}

		protected override void InitControlToDropValue()
		{
			UltraCalculatorDropDown.CalcDropDownHost.ResetControl();
			Calculator.Clear();
			if (UltraCalculatorDropDown.CaclulatorDropDownStyle != CaclulatorDropDownStyle.KeepCurrentValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				decimal num = decimal.Parse(((Control)(object)((EditorWithText)this).TextBox).Text);
				for (int i = 0; i < ((Control)(object)((EditorWithText)this).TextBox).Text.Length; i++)
				{
					Calculator.PushButton(((Control)(object)((EditorWithText)this).TextBox).Text[i].ToString());
				}
				if (((Control)(object)((EditorWithText)this).TextBox).Text.StartsWith("-"))
				{
					Calculator.PushButton("+/-");
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				Calculator.Clear();
			}
		}

		public override Type GetEmbeddableElementType()
		{
			return typeof(EmbeddableCalcDropDownUIElement);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (createdDropdownControl && ultraCalculatorDropDown != null)
			{
				((Component)(object)ultraCalculatorDropDown).Dispose();
			}
			((EditorWithText)this).OnDispose();
		}

		public override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).IsInEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).IsDroppedDown && (keyData == Keys.Return || keyData == Keys.Escape))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Calculator.InternalIsInputKey(keyData);
		}

		public override bool CanRenderType(Type type)
		{
			if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).DataFilter != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (null != type)
			{
				if (typeof(decimal) == type || typeof(int) == type || typeof(long) == type || typeof(float) == type || typeof(double) == type || typeof(string) == type)
				{
					return true;
				}
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(type);
				if (converter != null && converter.CanConvertTo(typeof(decimal)))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool CanEditType(Type type)
		{
			if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).DataFilter != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (null != type)
			{
				if (typeof(decimal) == type || typeof(int) == type || typeof(long) == type || typeof(float) == type || typeof(double) == type || typeof(string) == type)
				{
					return true;
				}
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(type);
				if (converter != null && converter.CanConvertTo(typeof(decimal)))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IEmbeddableTextBoxListener.OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).IsDroppedDown && Calculator.InternalIsInputKey(e.KeyData))
			{
				Calculator.ProcessKeyDown(e.KeyData);
				if (e.KeyData == Keys.Return || (e.KeyData == Keys.Oemplus && UltraCalculatorDropDown.AutoCloseUpOnEquals))
				{
					lastKeyDownCausedCloseUp = true;
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).CloseUp();
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		void IEmbeddableTextBoxListener.OnKeyPress(KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)this).IsDroppedDown)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			if (lastKeyDownCausedCloseUp)
			{
				lastKeyDownCausedCloseUp = false;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		public override EmbeddableEditorBase Clone(EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase defaultOwner)
		{
			CalcDropDownEditor calcDropDownEditor = new CalcDropDownEditor(defaultOwner, ultraCalculatorDropDown);
			((EmbeddableEditorBase)calcDropDownEditor).InitializeFrom((EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)this);
			return (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)calcDropDownEditor;
		}

		protected override object GetAutoConvertedDestinationValue(ConversionDirection direction, object sourceVal, Type destinationType, out bool isValidConversion, EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase owner, object ownerContext)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)direction == 3)
			{
				object obj = sourceVal;
				isValidConversion = true;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					try
					{
						obj = decimal.Parse(obj.ToString());
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return obj;
			}
			return ((EditorWithText)this).GetAutoConvertedDestinationValue(direction, sourceVal, destinationType, ref isValidConversion, owner, ownerContext);
		}
	}

		{
			private UltraCalculator Calculator => base.Owner as UltraCalculator;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.Grouping;

			public UltraCalculatorAccessibleObject(UltraCalculator calculator)
				: base((Control)(object)calculator)
			{
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				switch (index)
				{
				case 0:
					return Calculator.EditAreaAccessibilityObject;
				case 1:
					return Calculator.MemoryIndicatorAccessibilityObject;
				default:
				{
					int num = index - 2;
					if (num >= 0 && num < Calculator.Buttons.Count)
					{
						return Calculator.Buttons[num].AccessibilityObject;
					}
					return base.GetChild(index);
				}
				}
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return Calculator.Buttons.Count + 2;
			}
		}

					Control control = ((val == null) ? null : val.Control);
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)

					return Rectangle.Empty;

		{
			private UltraCalculator calculator;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string text = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (text == null)

						text = calculator.MemoryDisplayText;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.StaticText;

			public override AccessibleStates State => AccessibleStates.ReadOnly;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = calculator.UIElement;
					UIElement val = null;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						UIElementEnumerator enumerator = uIElement.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
						try
						{
							while (enumerator.MoveNext())
							{
								UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
								if (current is TextUIElement && !(current is CalculatorTextUIElement))
								{
									val = current;
								}
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
							{
								disposable.Dispose();
							}
						}
					}
					Control control = ((uIElement == null) ? null : uIElement.Control);
					if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
					{
						return control.RectangleToScreen(val.Rect);
					}
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

			{
				this.calculator = calculator;
			}

				return (Control)(object)calculator;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				return calculator.NavigateChildren(navdir, ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject);
			}

		public void PushButton(string key)
		{
			PushButton(GetButtonFromKey(key));
		}

		internal void PushButton(CalculatorButton button)
		{
			string text = GetMemoryText();
			DefaultCalculatorEngine.PushButton(button);
			((Control)(object)this).Text = DefaultCalculatorEngine.DisplayString;
			if (text != GetMemoryText())
			{
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		public void ParseString(string text)
		{
			DefaultCalculatorEngine.ClearAll();
			string[] array = SplitParseString(text);
			if (array == null)
			{
				string errorMessage = string.Empty;
				if (DefaultCalculatorEngine.HandleParseError(text, out errorMessage))
				{
					((Control)(object)this).Text = errorMessage;
					if (UIElement != null)
					{
						UIElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			CalculatorButton calculatorButton = null;
			for (int i = 0; i <= array.GetUpperBound(0); i++)
			{
				calculatorButton = GetButtonFromKey(array[i]);
				if (calculatorButton == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				OnCalcButtonClick(calculatorButton);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			DefaultCalculatorEngine.ClearAll();
			((Control)(object)this).Text = DefaultCalculatorEngine.DisplayString;
		}

		public void ClearEntry()
		{
			DefaultCalculatorEngine.ClearEntry();
			((Control)(object)this).Text = DefaultCalculatorEngine.DisplayString;
		}

		public void BackSpace()
		{
			DefaultCalculatorEngine.BackSpace();
			((Control)(object)this).Text = DefaultCalculatorEngine.DisplayString;
		}

			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)borderStyle > 0;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (components != null)
				{
					components.Dispose();
				}
				if (defaultCalculatorEngine != null)
				{
					defaultCalculatorEngine.BeforeCalculateImmediate -= CalculatorEngine_BeforeCalculateImmediate;
					defaultCalculatorEngine.BeforeCalculatePending -= CalculatorEngine_BeforeCalculatePending;
					defaultCalculatorEngine.DefaultCalculationFail -= CalculatorEngine_DefaultCalculationFail;
					defaultCalculatorEngine.AfterCalculateImmediate -= CalculatorEngine_AfterCalculateImmediate;
					defaultCalculatorEngine.BeforeActionButtonPressed -= CalculatorEngine_BeforeActionButtonPressed;
					defaultCalculatorEngine.AfterCalculatePending -= CalculatorEngine_AfterCalculatePending;
					defaultCalculatorEngine.AfterActionButtonPressed -= CalculatorEngine_AfterActionButtonPressed;
					defaultCalculatorEngine.AfterCalculationComplete -= CalculatorEngine_AfterCalculationComplete;
					defaultCalculatorEngine.BeforeButtonClicked -= CalculatorEngine_BeforeButtonClicked;
					defaultCalculatorEngine.AfterButtonClicked -= CalculatorEngine_AfterButtonClicked;
					defaultCalculatorEngine = null;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		{

				if (HasAppearance && propChangeInfo.Source == appearanceHolder.RootAppearance)

					SyncBackColor();

					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)58, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (HasButtonAppearance && buttonAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
				{
					((UIElement)UltraCalculatorUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)58, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (HasButtonHotTrackingAppearance && buttonHotTrackingAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
				{
					((UIElement)UltraCalculatorUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)58, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (HasEditAppearance && editAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
				{
					((UIElement)UltraCalculatorUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)58, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (HasEditAppearance && editAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
				{
					((UIElement)UltraCalculatorUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)58, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (buttons == propChangeInfo.Source)
				{
					((UIElement)UltraCalculatorUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(PropertyID)1, propChangeInfo);
				}
			}
		}
