		private string[] SplitParseString(string text)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = i; j < text.Length && text[j] == ' '; j++)
				{
				}
				if (IsToken(text[i]))
				{
					if (text[i] == ':')
					{
						for (int k = i; k < text.Length; k++)
						{
							if (text[k] != ' ')
							{
								i = k;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (i != text.Length)
						{
							i++;
						}
						if (IsToken(text[i]) || char.IsDigit(text[i]))
						{
							return new string[0];
						}
						switch (text[i])
						{
						case 'c':
							arrayList.Add("MC");
							break;
						case 'm':
							arrayList.Add("MS");
							break;
						case 'p':
							arrayList.Add("M+");
							break;
						case 'r':
							arrayList.Add("MR");
							break;
						default:
							arrayList.Add("C");
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList.Add(text[i].ToString());
					}
				}
				else if (char.IsDigit(text[i]))
				{
					arrayList.Add(text[i].ToString());
				}
				else if (text[i].ToString() == DecimalSymbol)
				{
					arrayList.Add(".");
				}
				else if (text[i].ToString() != GroupSymbol)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			string[] array = new string[arrayList.Count];
			arrayList.CopyTo(array);
			return array;
		}

		private bool IsToken(char token)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i <= parsingSymbolTable.GetUpperBound(0); i++)
			{
				if (token == parsingSymbolTable[i])
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal string GetMemoryText()
		{
			if (!DefaultCalculatorEngine.HasMemoryValue)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return memoryText;
		}

		private CalculatorButton GetButtonFromKey(string key)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Buttons.Count; i++)
			{
				if (Buttons[i].Key == key)
				{
					return Buttons[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void OnCalcButtonClick(CalculatorButton button)
		{
			string text = GetMemoryText();
			DefaultCalculatorEngine.PushButton(button);
			((Control)(object)this).Text = DefaultCalculatorEngine.DisplayString;
			if (text != GetMemoryText())
			{
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsMemoryButton(CalculatorButton button)
		{
			int num = Buttons.IndexOf(button);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return num <= 3;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsCustomButton(CalculatorButton button)
		{
			int num = Buttons.IndexOf(button);
			if (num >= 24)
			{
				return num <= 31;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsButtonVisible(CalculatorButton button)
		{
			if (button == null || !button.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ShowCustomButtons && IsCustomButton(button))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ShowMemoryButtons && IsMemoryButton(button))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((Control)this).Visible;
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Buttons.Count; i++)
			{
				if (keyData == Buttons[i].KeyCode || keyData == Buttons[i].KeyCodeAlternate)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool InternalIsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			return ((Control)(object)this).IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

		public void ResolveButtonAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolveButtonAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, resolveDefaults: true);
		}

		internal void ResolveButtonAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool resolveDefaults)
		{
			if (HasButtonAppearance)
			{
				buttonAppearanceHolder.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				if ((long)requestedProps == 0L)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (resolveDefaults)
			{
				ResolveButtonAppearanceDefaults(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveButtonAppearanceDefaults(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)4))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BorderColor = SystemColors.ControlDark;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x40000000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1073741824))
			{
				Color borderColor3DBase = ((HasButtonAppearance && ButtonAppearance.HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1)) ? ButtonAppearance.BackColor : SystemColors.Control);
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BorderColor3DBase = borderColor3DBase;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFFuL);
			}
		}

		public void ResolveEditAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.Role.UltraCalculatorEditArea, out resOrder);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (HasEditAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				editAppearanceHolder.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				if ((long)requestedProps == 0L)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BackColor = SystemColors.Window;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)32))

				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x40000000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1073741824))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BorderColor3DBase = SystemColors.Control;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)4))

				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);

				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);

		public void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.Role.UltraCalculator, out resOrder);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (HasAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				appearanceHolder.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				if ((long)requestedProps == 0L)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x100000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1048576))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BackColorDisabled = SystemColors.Control;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFEFFFFFuL);
			}
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 0x80000uL) != 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)524288))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ForeColorDisabled = SystemColors.ControlDark;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFF7FFFFuL);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnKeyDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				e.Handled = ProcessKeyDown(e.KeyData);
			}
		}

		internal bool ProcessKeyDown(Keys keyData)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Buttons.Count; i++)
			{
				if (keyData == Buttons[i].KeyCode)
				{
					PushButton(Buttons[i]);
					return true;
				}
				if (keyData == Buttons[i].KeyCodeAlternate)
				{
					PushButton(Buttons[i]);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

			return new UltraCalculatorAccessibleObject(this);
		}

		protected virtual AccessibleObject CreateEditAreaAccessibilityInstance()

		}

		internal AccessibleObject NavigateChildren(AccessibleNavigation direction, object child)
		{
			int num;
			if (child == MemoryIndicatorAccessibilityObject)
			{
				num = -2;
			}
			else if (child == EditAreaAccessibilityObject)
			{
				num = -3;
			}
			else
			{
				CalculatorButton calculatorButton = child as CalculatorButton;
				if (calculatorButton == null && child is CalculatorButton.CalculatorButtonAccessibleObject)
				{
					calculatorButton = ((CalculatorButton.CalculatorButtonAccessibleObject)child).Button;
				}
				if (calculatorButton == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				num = Buttons.IndexOf(calculatorButton);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			int num2 = -1;
			int num3 = -1;
			int num4 = BasicButtonLayout.GetUpperBound(0) + 1;
			int num5 = BasicButtonLayout.GetUpperBound(1) + 1;
			for (int i = 0; i < num4; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num5; j++)
				{
					if (BasicButtonLayout[i, j] == num)
					{
						num2 = i;
						num3 = j;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num2 != -1)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num6 = num2;
			int num7 = num3;
			int num12;
			do
			{
				int num8;
				int num9;
				int num10;
				int num11;
				switch (direction)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					num2--;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
					num3--;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					num2++;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					num3++;
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
					num8 = 1;
					goto IL_010c;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					num8 = -1;
					goto IL_010c;
				default:
					{
						return null;
					}
					IL_010c:
					num9 = num8;
					num10 = num4 * num5 - 1;
					num11 = num3 + num2 * num5;
					num11 += num9;
					num2 = num11 / num5;
					num3 = num11 % num5;
					break;
				}
				if (num2 < 0 || num3 < 0 || num2 >= num4 || num3 >= num5)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (num6 == num2 && num7 == num3)
				{
					return null;
				}
				num12 = BasicButtonLayout[num2, num3];
				if (num12 == -1)
				{
					switch (direction)
					{
					case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
						return MemoryIndicatorAccessibilityObject;
					case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
						return EditAreaAccessibilityObject;
					}
				}
			}
			while (num12 == num || num12 == -1);
			if (num12 == -2)
			{
				return MemoryIndicatorAccessibilityObject;
			}
			if (num12 == -3)
			{
				return EditAreaAccessibilityObject;
			}
			if (num12 >= 0 && num12 < Buttons.Count)
			{
				return Buttons[num12].AccessibilityObject;
			}
			return null;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			isInitializing = true;
			OnBeginInit();
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			OnEndInit();
			isInitializing = false;
		}

		}

		internal void SyncBackColor()
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((Control)this).BackColor = Utilities.ResolveControlBackColor(StyleUtils.GetMainRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this), StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder((UltraControlBase)(object)this), HasAppearance ? Appearance : null, backColorInternal, ((Control)this).Enabled);
		}

		protected override void OnCreateControl()
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnCreateControl();
			SyncBackColor();
		}

		internal void OnAppStyleChanged()
		{
			SyncBackColor();
		}

		protected override void OnEnabledChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			SyncBackColor();
			((Control)this).OnEnabledChanged(e);
		}
	}

				((Control)(object)calcDropDownHostValue).Size = size;

			}
		}

		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (CalcDropDownHost != null)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)CalcDropDownHost).UseOsThemes = ((UltraControlBase)this).UseOsThemes;
				if (CalcDropDownHost.UltraCalculatorDropDown != null)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)CalcDropDownHost.UltraCalculatorDropDown).UseOsThemes = ((UltraControlBase)this).UseOsThemes;
				}
			}
			base.OnBeforeDropDown(args);
		}

	public class UltraCalculatorDropDownUIElement : EditorWithTextDropDownControlUIElementBase
	{
		public UltraCalculatorDropDownUIElement(UltraCalculatorDropDown control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}
	}
	public class UltraCalculatorDropDownOwnerInfo : EditorWithTextDropDownControlOwnerBase
	{
		private UltraCalculatorDropDown owner;

		public UltraCalculatorDropDownOwnerInfo(UltraCalculatorDropDown owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public override void GetFormatInfo(object ownerContext, out string format, out IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			format = null;
			provider = null;
			if (owner.AutoDetectDecimalSymbol && owner.AutoDetectGroupSymbol)
			{
				provider = null;
				return;
			}
			if (owner.DecimalSymbol == CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator && owner.GroupSymbol == CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.NumberFormat.NumberGroupSeparator)
			{
				provider = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
				return;
			}
			IFormatProvider formatProvider = new CultureInfo(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.Name);
			if (!owner.AutoDetectDecimalSymbol || !owner.AutoDetectGroupSymbol)
			{
				NumberFormatInfo numberFormatInfo = formatProvider.GetFormat(typeof(NumberFormatInfo)) as NumberFormatInfo;
				if (numberFormatInfo != null && !owner.AutoDetectDecimalSymbol)
				{
					numberFormatInfo.NumberDecimalSeparator = owner.DecimalSymbol;
				}
				if (numberFormatInfo != null && !owner.AutoDetectGroupSymbol)
				{
					numberFormatInfo.NumberGroupSeparator = owner.GroupSymbol;
				}
			}
			provider = formatProvider;
		}
	}
	public class UltraCalculatorUIElement : ControlUIElementBase
	{
		private readonly int defaultTextHeight = 24;

		private readonly int defaultCalcButtonHeight = 28;

		private readonly int defaultCalcButtonWidth = 36;

		private readonly int defaultEditButtonHeight = 29;

		private readonly int defaultEditButtonWidth = 63;

		private readonly int defaultEditButtonTopSpace = 12;

		private readonly int defaultButtonSpacing = 4;

		private CalculatorTextUIElement textElement;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => UltraCalculator.BorderStyleResolved;

		public override UIRole UIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole(((UIElement)this).GetComponentRole(), StyleUtils.Role.UltraCalculator);

		private UltraCalculator UltraCalculator => ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraCalculator;

		internal CalculatorTextUIElement TextElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (textElement == null)
				{
					textElement = new CalculatorTextUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, "0" + UltraCalculator.DecimalSymbol);
					((TextUIElement)textElement).TextHAlign = (HAlign)3;
				}
				return textElement;
			}
		}

		private Size OriginalControlSize
		{
			get
			{
				int num = defaultCalcButtonWidth + defaultButtonSpacing;
				int num2 = 248;
				int height = 195;
				if (!UltraCalculator.ShowMemoryButtons)
				{
					num2 -= num + defaultButtonSpacing;
				}
				if (UltraCalculator.ShowCustomButtons)
				{
					num2 += 2 * num + defaultButtonSpacing;
				}
				return new Size(num2, height);
			}
		}

		public override RightToLeft RightToLeft => ((UIElement)this).Control.RightToLeft;

		public UltraCalculatorUIElement(UltraCalculator ultraCalculator)
			: base((Control)(object)ultraCalculator, (IUltraControl)(object)ultraCalculator)
		{
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			UltraCalculator.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((ControlUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			if (UltraCalculator.CalculatorStyle == CalculatorStyle.Basic)
			{
				PositionBasicLayout();
			}
		}

		private void PositionBasicLayout()
		{

		private void PositionCalcButtonSet(int startIndex, int endIndex, int rowCount, Rectangle rectBound, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			float num = 1f / (float)OriginalControlSize.Width * (float)((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Width;
			float num2 = 1f / (float)OriginalControlSize.Height * (float)((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Height;
			SizeF sizeF = new SizeF((float)defaultCalcButtonWidth * num, (float)defaultCalcButtonHeight * num2);
			int num3 = (int)((float)defaultButtonSpacing * num);
			int num4 = (int)((float)defaultButtonSpacing * num2);
			int num5 = (endIndex - startIndex) / rowCount;
			if ((endIndex - startIndex) % rowCount != 0)
			{
				num5++;
			}
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(rectBound.Location, sizeF.ToSize());
			int num6 = rectBound.Width - (rect.Width * num5 + num3 * (num5 - 1));
			int num7 = num6 / num5;
			int num8 = startIndex;
			for (int i = 0; i < num5; i++)
			{
				rect.Y = rectBound.Location.Y;
				for (int j = 0; j < rowCount; j++)
				{
					CalculatorButtonUIElement calculatorButtonUIElement = GetCalculatorButtonUIElement(oldElements, UltraCalculator.Buttons[num8]);
					((UIElement)calculatorButtonUIElement).Rect = rect;
					if (i == num5 - 1)
					{
						Rectangle rect2 = ((UIElement)calculatorButtonUIElement).Rect;
						rect2.Width += rectBound.Right - rect2.Right;
						((UIElement)calculatorButtonUIElement).Rect = rect2;
					}
					else
					{
						Rectangle rect3 = ((UIElement)calculatorButtonUIElement).Rect;
						rect3.Width += num7;
						((UIElement)calculatorButtonUIElement).Rect = rect3;
					}
					if (j == rowCount - 1)
					{
						Rectangle rect4 = ((UIElement)calculatorButtonUIElement).Rect;
						rect4.Height += ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Bottom - rect.Bottom - 1;
						((UIElement)calculatorButtonUIElement).Rect = rect4;
					}
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)calculatorButtonUIElement);
					rect.Y += rect.Height + num4;
					num8++;
				}
				rect.X = rect.Right + num3;
			}
		}

		private CalculatorButtonUIElement GetCalculatorButtonUIElement(UIElementsCollection oldElements, CalculatorButton buttonContext)
		{
			CalculatorButtonUIElement calculatorButtonUIElement = (CalculatorButtonUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(CalculatorButtonUIElement), true);
			if (calculatorButtonUIElement == null)
			{
				calculatorButtonUIElement = new CalculatorButtonUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, buttonContext);
			}
			else
			{
				calculatorButtonUIElement.Initialize(buttonContext);
			}
			return calculatorButtonUIElement;
		}

		private TextUIElement GetTextUIElement(UIElementsCollection oldElements, string text)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			TextUIElement val = (TextUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(TextUIElement), true);
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = new TextUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, text);
			}
			else
			{
				((TextUIElementBase)val).Text = text;
			}
			((UIElement)val).BorderStyle = (UIElementBorderStyle)5;
			val.TextHAlign = (HAlign)2;
			val.TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
			return val;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Shared

	internal sealed class SR
	{
		private static Infragistics.Shared.SR loader;

		private ResourceManager[] resources;

		private SR()
		{
			string text = "Infragistics.Win.UltraWinEditors.strings";
			string[] array = text.Split(';');
			int num = 0;
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text2 in array2)
			{
				if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			resources = new ResourceManager[num];
			Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
			int num2 = 0;
			string[] array3 = array;
			foreach (string text3 in array3)
			{
				if (text3 != null && text3.Length > 0)
				{
					resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text3, assembly);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Infragistics.Shared.SR GetLoader()
		{
			if (loader == null)
			{
				lock (typeof(Infragistics.Shared.SR))
				{
					if (loader == null)
					{
						loader = new Infragistics.Shared.SR();
					}
				}
			}
			return loader;
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
		}

		private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (allowCustomizedStrings)
			{
				text = global::ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				Infragistics.Shared.SR sR = GetLoader();
				if (sR == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			if (args != null && args.Length != 0 && text.Length > 2)
			{
				try
				{
					text = string.Format(null, text, args);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				string text = resourceManager.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text != null)
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: false, culture, name, args);
		}

		public static object GetObject(string name)
		{
			return GetObject(null, name);
		}

		public static object GetObject(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetLoader()?.GetObject(name, culture);
		}

		private object GetObject(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(name, culture);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					return obj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
